| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bb8598d2-e42a-4015-b84d-39afa907b4d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Spirit Airlines is gone. The bright yellow planes that helped working-class Americans fly for less have been [grounded](https://substack.com/redirect/f791a6ce-ba82-4ef7-b5b8-b23bf6c027aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), passengers were stranded, and thousands of employees have been left paying the price for years of financial weakness, regulatory warfare, and political grandstanding. Spirit announced an immediate wind-down on May 2, 2026, canceling all flights as part of its liquidation process.
LOOMER UNLEASHED is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..6qFih4K1O_Mv8JXgekL8J3Wz-ttIcat80_Z7f1Ua2sY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=197156427)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aa4ac9c8-1f86-4ca8-88cd-cbc9db4d9812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The media will blame fuel prices. Democrats will blame President Trump. But the full story begins years earlier, when Biden-era antitrust regulators, Senator Elizabeth Warren, Pete Buttigieg, and Democrat attorneys general celebrated the destruction of Spirit's best chance at survival.
In 2022, JetBlue agreed to [buy](https://substack.com/redirect/4360b7e8-56ed-42b9-8ee4-c728568944be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Spirit for $3.8 billion. The combined airline would still have been far smaller than the legacy giants, controlling 9% of the market compared to 75%, but it would have had more scale, more routes, and a better chance to compete against Delta, United, American, and Southwest. Instead, the Biden Justice Department [sued](https://substack.com/redirect/c1a6c958-2141-47a9-b477-837497c0ccee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to block the merger, and in January 2024 a federal court sided with DOJ. JetBlue and Spirit [terminated ](https://substack.com/redirect/19f0113c-b12e-47b7-99b6-ad1fcd89bc96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)the deal in March 2024.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0d1ec562-2951-4c76-97a1-67fc59ee88e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Elizabeth Warren [cheered](https://substack.com/redirect/8f5602d7-688a-44e3-83b6-a180f14639d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). She called the blocked merger a "Biden win for flyers," claiming it would keep fares low. Now Spirit is dead, and the "win" she celebrated has become a disaster for travelers who depended on one of America's most aggressive low-cost carriers.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..6qFih4K1O_Mv8JXgekL8J3Wz-ttIcat80_Z7f1Ua2sY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=197156427)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/42b9ef05-fc80-4d6c-958f-259612246881?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Pete Buttigieg's Department of Transportation helped [push](https://substack.com/redirect/d43a9a64-bff4-4140-a82a-b3e74db93512?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the same fantasy: that blocking a merger between two smaller carriers would somehow protect consumers from the airline giants. In reality, the government preserved Spirit just long enough for it to collapse.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b03fa37c-c503-4a0e-bf8f-f3e96d699296?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Democrat attorneys general piled on, too. California Attorney General Rob Bonta [celebrated ](https://substack.com/redirect/e544071f-24b7-4f65-bf99-4ca5e86c0add?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)the court order blocking JetBlue's acquisition, while former North Carolina Attorney General Josh Stein [joined](https://substack.com/redirect/e9f7d2ad-3d01-437c-ad24-633e2458b694?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the lawsuit with other Democrat-led states. They all claimed they were protecting competition.
But competition is only protected by businesses that can survive.
Spirit had been struggling for years. It faced debt, post-COVID travel disruption, aircraft problems, and rising costs. But when regulators killed the JetBlue deal, they removed a private-sector lifeline and left Spirit exposed. When the final pressure came, the airline had nowhere to go.
This is the brutal irony of left-wing antitrust activism. The Biden administration claimed it was fighting consolidation. Instead, it helped produce the most extreme form of consolidation possible: one less competitor in the marketplace.
The Big Four are still standing. Spirit is not. And two of the world's largest carriers, American Airlines and United, recently discussed [merging](https://substack.com/redirect/45f98a93-4706-49a3-b527-b38ddbff9c27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which would create an air travel behemoth in the U.S. marketplace.
American travelers were told that bureaucrats in Washington knew better than the market. They were told Elizabeth Warren, Merrick Garland, Pete Buttigieg, and Democrat attorneys general were saving low-cost airfare. Now the planes are grounded, the routes are gone, and the workers are out of jobs.
This was not consumer protection. It was government malpractice.
Once again, working Americans are stuck with the bill.

| Peter,
When the Supreme Court struck down the legislation that ended segregationist voter suppression, the Voting Rights Act, many were quick to say that this was the end of Democratic power in the Deep South.
These doubting Thomases grew louder when the MAGA Governor of Louisiana declared a 'state of emergency' and canceled our House elections, a move which, combined with a massive disinformation effort, convinced many Louisianans that all May 16th elections were canceled.
But then the unthinkable happened. Democrats took the lead.
Driving this turn of fortune are the Louisiana Dems' emergency communications (texts, mailers, etc.), sent to alert voters that multiple elections are still happening.

| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gly2NhkVH4_O592zkfM3HLhmqu0lxl_v8dqSZI6A2V69jdBRxUh08qvIMGle_EljLoS8xvojr5l4H1f2xueZa3HsVkNZMGUAgbWgTO_hSp2khUbKSV7mLTm3vL1AYfVRIh88f6FYghN8DppEonnyTSgr-Z9iI8cKNKVeNnyjXqOYRt45c-GYCBy3exwmSfuTZJEp1-zH0da1IJBvMKybAuT71x20Otit&c=9tHc5gpIXNTCWfy0nurCI62sHTzI_c3uqKJ8Kkg4FVY4XCm4o2sd7w==&ch=V9tj_zdaulZzfxYjGsDXmqp8UDPLUEC-dNj0V8Z4hJ8Z_Y2ba7fzOA==)

We are one of the most underfunded parties in the nation so the way we've funded this lightning breakthrough is extremely unorthodox.
On the day the Supreme Court decision dropped, we had very little money in the bank. However, on that day, and in the days that followed, we began operating under an assumption of faith that Democrats from across the nation would come in to back us up.
The faith that we started this with is now reaping dividends. Backed by hundreds of thousands of small-dollar donors, we've been able to launch an unprecedented counterattack that now has us leading in this life-or-death election.
We cannot relent. Until election day, we have to continue spending money that we don't have under the assumption that we will raise it back tomorrow. body:
While America continues to face a tough moment, we need to hear your thoughts on this, Peter:
#
We’ll keep this quick, Peter — but we do need your input.
**While America continues to face a tough moment, with corruption running rampant and distrust in our government growing more and more each day, we’re wondering:**
**What does real patriotism mean to you right now?**
**[SHARE YOUR THOUGHTS ON PATRIOTISM HERE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/survey/hp-patriotism-survey-20260513?t=1&akid=10450%2E614464%2EOeLNqr)**
**For too long, patriotism has been defined by blind support of our country. But in this moment we’re facing now, we know your answer might be more complex.**
Maybe patriotism means standing up to defend our freedoms — including reproductive freedom and the right to make decisions about our own bodies, families, and lives. Maybe patriotism means holding our government accountable for its actions, even when it might feel impossible. Or maybe it’s something else entirely.
**No matter what it is, we want to hear your thoughts on patriotism today, Peter.**
**[Just click the button below to share more. Your input will inform how we approach electing real patriots over the next cycle and beyond.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/survey/hp-patriotism-survey-20260513?t=2&akid=10450%2E614464%2EOeLNqr)**

Hello friends,
We're excited to invite you to a Suozzi for Congress Primary Canvass Launch on Saturday, May 16th at 10:30am! We'd love to have you there, whether you've volunteered with us before or this is your first time getting involved.
Come meet Rep. Suozzi, connect with neighbors, and help us reach voters ahead of the June 23rd primary. No experience necessary — we'll show you everything you need to know. And If you prefer not to canvass, we’ll have other volunteer activities too!
**Where: Our new headquarters at 227 Forest Avenue, Glen Cove, NY 11542****When: Saturday, May 16th at 10:30am**
RSVP through Mobilize: https://www.mobilize.us/suozziforcongress/event/951996/_Feel free to RSVP our team via email - madsionforman05@gmail.com or aidands2026@gmail.com_
A huge thank you to everyone who turned out for our Petitioning Thank You and Organizing Party last Sunday — it was wonderful to see familiar faces and meet so many new supporters ready to help.
If you've been looking for a way to get involved, this is the perfect place to start. We hope to see you Saturday!

name: Christina Bohannan (personal)
subject: Controlling your own destiny
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRISTINA BOHANNAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
| Peter, to me, freedom is being able to control your own destiny.

That means the right of free speech, the right to protect your property from being taken by the government for corporate profit, the right to grow through education, the right to make your own healthcare decisions, the right to safe and healthy communities free from crime and pollution, and the right to participate in a fair and open economy in which hardworking people get a shot to get ahead.

Our freedoms are not safe with Mariannette Miller-Meeks. She's proudly championed laws that oppress hardworking people to benefit billionaires. And she has been a leading voice in taking away our right to make our own health care decisions.

Thanks to her efforts, Iowans suffered a shocking blow to our freedom in 2024, when Iowa imposed one of the strictest abortion bans in the country. Then she went even further, sponsoring a nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. Her abortion ban could even end IVF fertility treatments nationwide.

As we knock on doors across this district to talk with voters, it's clear to me that Iowans value our freedom and just want leaders who will help them build a good life. They're sick of politicians like Miller-Meeks pushing their own dangerous agendas instead of listening to their needs.

I'm not running for a title or an office. I'm running to serve my community and defend their freedoms. Every Iowan deserves the opportunity to thrive and make their way in life as they see fit. **If you're with me, make a donation to my campaign’s $10,000 mid-month goal to help me win in November >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cb-q2-2026?refcode2=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131309079/620662201/-2009658230?refcode=em26_260514_MM3_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260514_MM3_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=da6ec01a-d44e-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYTZlYzAxYS1kNDRlLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4BOfttGgtZ8Ax-GhW3f_XfT5YNx8icWtp2Fxfmo735Y=)**

Thank you,

Christina

| | , Both MAGA candidates for Texas Attorney General are now saying they want to overturn _Plyler v. Doe_ , the 1982 Supreme Court decision guaranteeing undocumented children access to free public education. **Not on my watch.** What a cruel way to use your power as a lawyer. Think about what they are saying. They want to punish children by denying them an education. They want the government to look a kid in the eye and say, “You do not get to learn here.” **No decent public servant should treat children this way.** Texans are sick of it and so am I. I am running for Texas Attorney General because I believe the law should protect people, not target the vulnerable. The Office of Attorney General should not be a weapon used to score political points against children and families. **We have had enough madness shoved in our faces by people who think cruelty is leadership.** [**Together, we can stop this and start building a Texas that works for everyone. Winning this May 26 runoff is the first step.**](https://us.list-manage.com/C2quBzm2RIC?e=5d8d80652b&c2id=5b7253848400ad0bc149d15cc002d544) [**Support this campaign now and help us get this message out**](https://us.list-manage.com/NMZTeAaw5Gv?e=5d8d80652b&c2id=5b7253848400ad0bc149d15cc002d544)! Using the greenlight given to them by SCOTUS, Louisiana Republicans are suspending the election to accelerate the timeline for a Jim Crow redistrict of our state before Democrats can mount a defense. | | |
**[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsCgbBF5rm9TF3OCm2PlAzc830mH0SaEU79yenHkofnNxmYVU0KaNelsGDLQBgZYnw_TLU4ud3LTKaTO7PuapHWBtSwDuHOU_1PJDmfavtIPgdYAhmHGItQEF5WapM_JR6q0INeN7NB33PJb8TVk4AEoQTgYFB2ZsCw4UR8MVesKsOCcEkSDHhgh-BnXSrxB7DQTV5nJRNKpK9wwi-IW5FIwBQYdK63HPU0gEWyOwwiiUxzz08zmQeODAOjUgdQzy2EXFWg88xvkIgJlO-PvwKMTziz6CpojM9pPaNFsbyNdyY__q1iIUwDqVYmXe7HkUPkhmUGj1le0pRRv-AWX9K7/4ql/bbFy0qJkQ_m5F0xNvHKFQA/h0/h001.UPq-bInyOs1601zTy7FEa_lFXNlcsW3e3i0ZY51zPB0)** **** **** **** **** **** **** Peter, The MAGA-occupied Supreme Court issued a devastating ruling to **gut the legislation that ended Jim Crow,** the Voting Rights Act — the key federal protection that guaranteed minority representation in redistricting. Louisiana's 6th Congressional District, currently represented by Democrat Cleo Fields, was at the heart of this case. MAGA challenged the constitutionality of this majority-Black district and won, setting the stage for MAGA to wipe 25+ majority-Black districts off the map nationwide. Louisiana Republicans, empowered by this ruling, are now **_suspending_****our upcoming May 16th elections** : [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquKFy15A8mFPSkUiPsO1her-c49jJol9LEiOyBEzv9eDj48IczlaKn2JwXv77T9DnubbWjU5ZvMcSAR5Yd8q8nrTixhxE72UfuoHgO_YI0-oJGUbK1ObESAXTDHnmeYAg4O6-eS8u7kLiIvhSKgjCSTwUnv4KSAG0gGa819g-F-IwnzHb-5bT-k-_m8gTQ7pO67PxE_jAoJYnH3CvJ2msjrfbKT5eOif5nnT0GhVQUYCJSb8NL44XUpokKrm3ezy_md_YURPdUWtgOC_koF6LrXdnhU1cXMSzzus1CpX7OjqXVcgN1-G8Hd0ZVltiBq7uNElxOgbYBhYSJm1yG3Z8w-k-vEWe9lhFyKPZ5fUomvOA/4ql/bbFy0qJkQ_m5F0xNvHKFQA/h1/h001.3UwvwlvJwj7kPanyv34IEQJwPvoISDDSQNGQMFzw8nA)Using the greenlight given to them by SCOTUS, Louisiana Republicans are suspending the election to accelerate the timeline for a Jim Crow redistrict of our state before Democrats can mount a defense. They will then hold a new election using the racist new maps. **
** **It’s a racist power grab that will drag our state back to the darkest days of segregation.**
****Early voting is already underway for the May 16th election. Ballots have been printed. Votes have been cast. Suspending this election means confusing voters, invalidating votes, reprinting new ballots, and sending 64 parishes into chaos— _all to rush through a map that strips Black voters of their representation._
__Earlier this year, a Louisiana Democrat won by a landslide in a deep red Trump +13 district. The signs are becoming increasingly clear that a Democratic blue wave is coming to even deep red Louisiana.**This is a last ditch attempt to ensure MAGA does not lose Louisiana.** _
_ ****_If they succeed with suspending our election to stop our blue wave they lay the groundwork for suspending the upcoming 2026 midterms to prevent a blue wave nationally._

Hi Peter, it’s Jon Ossoff.
Five years ago, Georgia sent the young Jewish son of an immigrant and a Black pastor who holds Dr. King's pulpit at Ebenezer Baptist Church to the U.S. Senate — winning the Senate majority for Democrats.
And this year, our country is counting on us to win here again. Because only by regaining Congressional power can we stop the chaos and corruption of the Trump administration.
So if you’re ready to stop MAGA and restore checks and balances, please chip in what you can to support my campaign here in Georgia.
**Here’s the link to donate:[https://act.electjon.com/go/donate](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260513-1-f&t=2&akid=2253%2E5691347%2EkmpA6R)**
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for the Senate — and why these midterm elections are even more urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, Trump's rule reminds me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
I ran for Senate in Georgia because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency, and to confront the corruption that made his rise possible. We defeated him, and I won.
But now, this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history. This President has:
* Tried to jail elected leaders of the opposition and prosecute Americans who have defied or criticized him.

* Allowed masked federal agents to kick down Americans’ doors without so much as a warrant from a judge, assault and even kill Americans with apparent license from the very top.

* Used the office of the Presidency to enrich his family in a way we have never, ever seen in American history.

**This is not a drill, and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, this moment is the test of our lifetimes.**
The only way to dig ourselves out of this chaos is absolute victory in the midterms.
And just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please, make a contribution to my reelection campaign today, of $5 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260513-1-f&t=3&akid=2253%2E5691347%2EkmpA6R)

# **Mamdani unveils $124.7B budget with hidden fee hikes disguised as "savings," critics call it fiscal gimmickry**
Mayor Zohran Mamdani **[rolled out his first budget Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/44f1c89c-8b72-457d-88ed-e986f3c832fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** claiming to close a multibillion-dollar gap with $1.7 billion in savings over two years, but fiscal watchdogs slammed the plan as relying on revenue tricks and phantom efficiencies rather than real cuts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/44f1c89c-8b72-457d-88ed-e986f3c832fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The administration plans to raise ambulance transport costs by $25 million** annually, charge $10 million more for EMS assistance even when patients aren't hospitalized, increase enforcement revenues through bus lane tickets and trade waste crackdowns, and audit property tax credits more aggressively to collect an additional $24 million yearly--prompting one Democratic operative to say the budget is "as real as Kim Kardashian's lips."

* **DOE accounts for largest share through vague "cost containment" and "financial controls"**: The Department of Education shoulders the bulk of alleged savings with $149.5 million this year from "improved financial controls" and a staggering $922 million next year through unspecified measures including $30.3 million in procurement "reform." Other departments contributed minimal cuts like Veterans' Services slashing events to save $60,000 and Sanitation canceling battery disposal for $353,000.

# **Minnesota grocery owner charged with $1.1M food stamp fraud scheme using others ' EBT cards**
Abdidwahid Mohamed, owner of Minnesota Food Grocery LLC, **[allegedly used EBT cards registered to other people to buy products](https://substack.com/redirect/e8b0ed06-2bcb-4209-9ebc-07a5fab33437?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at Sam's Club and Costco in 2021 before reselling them in his store, according to Hennepin County authorities who observed him making purchases and tracked him back to his business. Investigators found many cardholders were either out of the country or denied shopping at those locations, with surveillance footage and GPS data supporting the case--Mohamed now faces up to 20 years in prison or a $100,000 fine if convicted.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e8b0ed06-2bcb-4209-9ebc-07a5fab33437?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **State Sen. Koran: "Private retailer, not the state" uncovered fraud**: Republican state Sen. Mark Koran said the case represents "yet another example of why Minnesota is target number one for fraudsters," noting the suspect was initially flagged by Walmart's Global Investigation Team rather than government agencies, highlighting what he called "the inability of state agencies to detect obvious fraud." Congressional candidate Dalia al-Aqidi said Minneapolis "didn't become America's fraud capital by accident," arguing money intended for vulnerable families is instead "lining the wrong pockets and paying for luxury cars and houses on the other side of the world."
* **Charges emerge amid broader Minnesota social services fraud scandal** : The case comes as Minnesota faces a massive fraud scandal within social services programs, particularly affecting the Somali community, alongside renewed Trump administration crackdowns on food stamp abuse.

| | Patriot,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---

_But now, Patriot, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

body:
A federal digital dollar isn't a payment upgrade. It's a leash.

| | | | | [|
---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=3124ef73c9&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,

I want to tell you about something most people in Washington do not want you to think too hard about.It is called a Central Bank Digital Currency. A CBDC. A federal digital dollar.If you have not heard much about it, that is by design. The people pushing for it would rather you only notice it after it is already on your phone.**Here is what it actually is.** Today, when you swipe a card, the dollars in your account are issued by private banks. Cash in your wallet is issued by the Federal Reserve, but once it leaves the ATM, the government has no idea where it goes.A CBDC changes that. Every dollar would be issued directly by the federal government, on a federal ledger, in a digital wallet the federal government controls. Every transaction you make - every meal, every grocery run, every donation, every gun shop receipt - sits in a federal database.And here is the part the bureaucrats do not put on the brochure. A programmable, federal dollar is not just trackable. It is controllable.**Flip one switch, and your dollars stop working at a firearms dealer.** Flip another, and your dollars stop working when you try to donate to your church.Flip another, and your dollars expire if you don't spend them on what the government wants you to spend them on.Flip another, and your dollars only work within a certain number of miles from your home.This is not a hypothetical. This is what is already happening overseas.China has rolled out the digital yuan across hundreds of millions of users. Iran is rolling theirs out now. The Bahamas, Nigeria, and Jamaica have launched the same kind of system. The European Central Bank is preparing a digital euro. And the Federal Reserve has been studying an American CBDC since 2022.In China, that system is already being used to lock dissidents out of the financial system, to enforce social credit penalties, and to surveil every transaction by every citizen. That is not a slippery slope. That is the operating manual.**Here is what I am doing about it.** ● I am a cosponsor of the CBDC Anti-Surveillance State Act that bans the Federal Reserve from issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency, period. Not a study. Not a pilot. Not a back door. A ban.● I am pushing the House Freedom Caucus to make a CBDC ban a non-negotiable line in every spending negotiation, so the Fed cannot quietly fund the work in an appropriations bill nobody reads.● I am voting against every single appropriations rider that funds CBDC research, pilot programs, or "public engagement" campaigns dressed up to look harmless.● And I am telling this story out loud because the only way the bureaucrats win this one is if you never find out it is happening.**Now let me be straight with you about the politics.** The people who want a digital dollar are not stupid. They are not going to call it a "kill switch." They are going to call it "modernizing the payment system." They are going to say it is "faster, safer, and more inclusive." They are going to point at the cash you already use every day and ask what is so different about a digital version.The difference is the switch. The difference is the ledger. The difference is who gets to decide what your money is allowed to do tomorrow.Cash does not care what you buy. A federal digital dollar will.**Here is the part where I have to be honest with you.** This fight does not end with one vote or one bill. The financial surveillance lobby is patient. They are well-funded. They have spent decades building the regulatory plumbing for this moment, and they are someone else in this seat, one who will not stand in their way.A donation today keeps me in this seat for one more cycle, so I can keep doing the work, keep voting against the CBDC, keep telling this story, keep fighting for the families who do not have time to track every quiet thing the Federal Reserve is up to.**Will you stand with me?**[**> > STAND WITH ME — DONATE TODAY <<**](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=522023ac67&e=5f9dc01b8c)
Even $10, $25, or $50 makes a real difference. It tells me you have my back. It tells the central-planning crowd that the people they are trying to leash are paying attention and we are organized.China built that system. We are NOT building it here. Not on my watch.Standing firm,

Every transaction you make - every meal, every grocery run, every donation, every gun shop receipt - sits in a federal database.And here is the part the bureaucrats do not put on the brochure. A programmable, federal dollar is not just trackable. It is controllable.Flip one switch, and your dollars stop working at a firearms dealer. Flip another, and your dollars stop working when you try to donate to your church.Flip another, and your dollars expire if you don't spend them on what the government wants you to spend them on.Flip another, and your dollars only work within a certain number of miles from your home.This is not a hypothetical. This is what is already happening overseas.China has rolled out the digital yuan across hundreds of millions of users. Iran is rolling theirs out now. The Bahamas, Nigeria, and Jamaica have launched the same kind of system. The European Central Bank is preparing a digital euro. And the Federal Reserve has been studying an American CBDC since 2022.In China, that system is already being used to lock dissidents out of the financial system, to enforce social credit penalties, and to surveil every transaction by every citizen. That is not a slippery slope. That is the operating manual.Here is what I am doing about it. ● I am a cosponsor of the CBDC Anti-Surveillance State Act that bans the Federal Reserve from issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency, period. Not a study. Not a pilot. Not a back door. A ban.● I am pushing the House Freedom Caucus to make a CBDC ban a non-negotiable line in every spending negotiation, so the Fed cannot quietly fund the work in an appropriations bill nobody reads.● I am voting against every single appropriations rider that funds CBDC research, pilot programs, or "public engagement" campaigns dressed up to look harmless.● And I am telling this story out loud because the only way the bureaucrats win this one is if you never find out it is happening.Now let me be straight with you about the politics. The people who want a digital dollar are not stupid. They are not going to call it a "kill switch." They are going to call it "modernizing the payment system." They are going to say it is "faster, safer, and more inclusive." They are going to point at the cash you already use every day and ask what is so different about a digital version.The difference is the switch. The difference is the ledger. The difference is who gets to decide what your money is allowed to do tomorrow.Cash does not care what you buy. A federal digital dollar will.Here is the part where I have to be honest with you. This fight does not end with one vote or one bill. The financial surveillance lobby is patient. They are well-funded. They have spent decades building the regulatory plumbing for this moment, and they are someone else in this seat, one who will not stand in their way.A donation today keeps me in this seat for one more cycle, so I can keep doing the work, keep voting against the CBDC, keep telling this story, keep fighting for the families who do not have time to track every quiet thing the Federal Reserve is up to.Will you stand with me? Even $10, $25, or $50 makes a real difference. It tells me you have my back. It tells the central-planning crowd that the people they are trying to leash are paying attention and we are organized.China built that system. We are NOT building it here. Not on my watch.Standing firm, | | | | | | | | | | Eric Burlison for Congress 2135 E. Independence Ave. #1007 Springfield, MO 65804 * USA or | | [Paid For By Eric Burlison for Congress]()

clean_body: | | | ** ** Friend, We knew it would be bad, but this is a full-blown declaration of war on the disabled community. The president - a man who has openly, shamelessly mocked people with disabilities on the national stage - is teaming up with his health secretary who thinks Tylenol and lifesaving vaccines cause autism to gut services to people with autism. It is a sickening anti-science crusade. While they claim there’s no money for the millions of autistic people who rely on Medicaid, they somehow find unlimited billions for foreign wars and massive tax giveaways for the ultra-rich. They aren't broke; they're just choosing their billionaire donors over our survival. By pushing "profound autism" labels to gatekeep care, they are stripping support from millions and dismantling the dignity we’ve fought decades to earn. The new restrictions make it nearly impossible to access the care our families need. We cannot let these conspiracy theorists and bullies win. At Able Dems, we are fighting like hell to elect disabled leaders and allies who actually believe we deserve a seat at the table, not a target on our backs. World War II was the most significant armed conflict in human history--fought across continents, oceans, and skies with unprecedented scale and intensity.

Yet despite its complexity, this war can be understood.

That's why we created this course, "The Second World Wars." It organizes the conflict into seven key topics--The Stakes, Air, Water, Earth, Fire, People, and Ends--to give you a clear understanding of how and why the Allies won.

In this course, you'll learn:
* what was at stake for civilization during World War II

* how different theaters of war shaped the outcome

* the strategies and investments of Allied and Axis powers

* the role of leadership, technology, and industrial strength

* how a global conflict became one unified war

To guide this journey, we are pleased to feature Dr. Victor Davis Hanson and Dr. Larry P. Arnn.

Together, they bring clarity and depth to one of the most complex events in history--helping you see not just what happened, but why it mattered.

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: This work matters more than ever
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR GOVERNOR]
body:
I started my career in Alabama working on civil rights issues, and as
Michigan’s Secretary of State, I’ve worked every day to make sure our
elections are secure, accessible, and fair for every eligible voter.

That’s why I was deeply concerned by the Supreme Court’s recent decision
weakening key protections in the Voting Rights Act. For decades, these
protections have allowed communities to challenge racially discriminatory
voting maps and ensure every voice has a fair chance to be heard.

Decisions like this have real consequences. They make it harder to
challenge unfair systems, harder to protect representation, and harder to
ensure that every community is treated equally under the law.

And at a moment when we’re already seeing growing efforts across the
country to undermine confidence in our elections and restrict access to
the ballot box, this work matters more than ever.

I believe protecting voting rights is fundamental to protecting our
democracy. It’s not a partisan issue. It’s about whether every eligible
voter has the freedom to make their voice heard and trust that their vote
counts.

That’s a fight I’ve never backed away from, and it’s one I’ll continue as
governor. But I can’t do it alone.

clean_body: They hoped you weren’t going to notice. | | | | | == | Peter, It's Congressman Cleo Fields (D-LA) -- a few hours ago a GOP led-committee advanced Senate Bill 121, legislation that redraws Louisiana's 6th Congressional District into a majority white district. | == At the same time, despite more than 40,000 ballots already having been cast in this election, the suspension of the election process leaves many voters questioning whether their voices will ultimately be heard. Let me be clear: I am in the fight of my life. MAGA Republicans are no longer hiding their plans. They want to take us backward and silence the voices of Black voters and communities that fought too hard for equal representation. But we are not going back. I will continue this fight through the entire legislative process and into the courts if necessary. We must protect our hard-fought right to fair and equal representation in Congress, and we must hold this seat. This will be one of the toughest and most relentless political fights of 2026. ✅ Letitia Plummer for Harris County Judge
MAY 30 in Dallas:
Right2Justic member retreat
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20R2J%20members.jpg]
TOP's Right2Justice (R2J) campaign is continuing to sharpen around probation reform, non-safety traffic stops, and the broader criminalization pipeline — including the criminalizing of immigrant communities across the country.
Attend our next R2J member retreat on Saturday, May 30 in Dallas to learn more on latest campaign developments and how we can expand our efforts.
Contact Dr. Doshie Piper at dpiper@organizetexas.org [dpiper@organizetexas.org] for more retreat details and to reserve your spot.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Car%20fueling%20up%20gas.png]

Friends,
Last week, Marie Claire published a sweeping interview [https://www.marieclaire.com/politics/congressional-pact-lamonica-mciver-ilhan-omar-alexandria-ocasio-cortez-nancy-pelosi/] with my friend, Rep. LaMonica McIver, 11 of my Democratic colleagues, and me — discussing how we’re standing together as a sisterhood to support LaMonica while she takes on Donald Trump and his vindictive administration.
In case you haven’t been following LaMonica’s case, here’s a brief rundown:
LaMonica McIver is a wife, a mom, and a freshman Congresswoman representing New Jersey’s 10th District. Last year, she joined her New Jersey colleagues in conducting a routine congressional oversight visit of Delaney Hall, an ICE detention facility in her district, after reports of detainees being unable to reach their lawyers.
Their delegation was met with resistance and aggression from ICE agents, and afterwards, the Trump administration charged LaMonica with completely baseless criminal charges – for simply doing her job.
If convicted, she faces up to 17 years in prison.
Trump is willing to go to extreme lengths to punish his political adversaries and anyone else who speaks out against him, which is why it’s so incredibly important for all of us to stand firm with LaMonica. For her sake, and for the future of our democracy, too.
Trump’s attacks against LaMonica are unprecedented and dangerous. And because this is completely new territory, the Democratic Party had no playbook for this. There was no institutional fund for legal fees and no system of support in place to help a young Member of Congress fight these charges in court.
LaMonica has had to raise her own legal defense — which has already exceeded a million dollars in fees — dollar by dollar, while still showing up every single day to do the job that she was elected to do: working on behalf of the people of NJ-10.
My colleagues and I knew early on that LaMonica would need our support, and so our sisterhood was created. We showed up to the courtroom in Newark and sat behind her, because we knew silence from colleagues would send its own message — the wrong one. And on a human level, I wanted to make sure LaMonica didn’t feel alone in that scary moment.
Here's what I've come to understand clearly during LaMonica’s unbelievable journey: Trump wants to make us feel alone and isolated.
This administration is trying to make an example out of LaMonica — to make her feel like no one has her back, no one is coming to her rescue, and that the repercussions of simply doing her job are hers alone to bear.
But she is not alone. And building community is exactly how we fight back against this cruel and corrupt administration.
Oral arguments in LaMonica’s case are set for June 23rd – six weeks from today. That’s the last chance to get these charges dismissed before trial. She needs resources to fight, and to continue representing the people of New Jersey’s 10th District. So I'm asking you to join our community: will you donate to LaMonica’s campaign to help her fight back today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em-support-mciver]

body:
This Supreme Court decision just made our work all the more critical.
#
Peter,
**The Supreme Court recently gutted the Voting Rights Act** , opening the floodgates for Republican-controlled states to immediately gerrymander congressional districts in their favor so they can consolidate their power in the midterm elections and beyond.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260513-1.Xq-6Mg&amount=5&refcode=em20260513-627&t=1&akid=627%2E34582%2EH9vj9l)
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260513-1.Xq-6Mg&amount=5&refcode=em20260513-627&t=2&akid=627%2E34582%2EH9vj9l)
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260513-1.Xq-6Mg&amount=5&refcode=em20260513-627&t=3&akid=627%2E34582%2EH9vj9l)
Republicans have been chomping at the bit for this day, slowly working to dismantle the Voting Rights Act piece by piece for decades, ever since it was enacted to ensure more fair and equitable representation for Black voters in Congress.
The GOP knows they can’t and won’t win in certain districts with their extreme agenda, so they eliminated them. Folks in states like Alabama, Tennessee, and Florida **saw some of their only blue districts completely disappear in a matter of days.** _That’s not right._
If Democrats are going to expand the map and take power back from these MAGA extremists so we can get back to making life better for our communities, we need to fight back, and _fast_.
Look, at the end of the day, our country needs nonpartisan redistricting reform at the federal level to ensure fair maps once and for all. **But as long as red states can cherry-pick and redraw districts in their favor, they should expect blue states to play by the same rules.**
It’s the only way we’re going to stop far-right fascism and billionaire-backed oligarchy from getting worse and hurting our small towns.
I started Small Town PAC to help recruit working-class candidates for office and give the Democratic Party new leadership that folks across the country are excited to turn out and vote for. This Supreme Court decision just made our work all the more critical.
[**We can’t just sit back and watch: will you pitch in $5 or whatever you can spare to fuel our fight against this GOP power grab and help elect more Democrats?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260513-1.Xq-6Mg&amount=5&refcode=em20260513-627&t=4&akid=627%2E34582%2EH9vj9l)

Let’s get to work.
— Tim

Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trina for Congress
body:
trinaforcongress.com [trinaforcongress.com]
Friends,
It’s been a week since the DFL endorsed me as the candidate for Congressional District 8, and I’ve had a chance to catch my breath and think about the next steps. I’m so grateful to the donors and volunteers who brought our campaign this far, with whom the idea of bringing opportunity home to central and northern Minnesota resonated enough that you took a chance on a political outsider starting from scratch.
Our eyes are on November, and unseating Pete Stauber – an official who’s been anything other than a representative, failing to engage or show up, voting against the interests of the district and then taking credit for programs he opposed! Pete loves a ribbon cutting, but not the work. I’m confident the people of MN8 want something better – and I know I can deliver.
But, first we have an August primary to win, and here’s how we are going to do that:
* We’ll continue to show up in all 21 countries of MN-8, talking to people about their hopes and worries. I’m planning a summer of campfire chats to hear what’s on people’s minds.
* We’ll offer concrete solutions for the problems impacting everyday Minnesotans. We’re all feeling it at the gas station and the grocery store, when choosing between childcare and career opportunities.
* We’ll bring together the communities working for real change in November. Getting out the vote matters more in 2026 than ever before.
How can you help?
* Spread the word about my campaign. Talk to your neighbors, put up a sign. Follow me on social media - Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Tik Tok or Twitter. Word of mouth from friend to friend and neighbor to neighbor carries a lot of weight these days. Making a point to reach out to just 5-10 new people a week to share my story and platform will allow us to reach 100s of additional people a week.

| Peter,
In the dead of the night, MAGA members of the Louisiana state legislature advanced a new gerrymandered map that eliminates one of the state's majority-Black and Democratic districts.
At approximately 4:25 a.m. this morning, under the cover of darkness, Louisiana Republicans advanced Senate Bill 121 out of committee, where it will now head to the MAGA controlled Senate for a vote.
The new gerrymandered map in S.B. 121 is the brainchild of Republican state Senator Jay Morris--the man who introduced the legislation that erased the office won by exonerated Black man Calvin Duncan, and just last week, told the Black Executive Director of our party to "shut up, boy" during a committee hearing.
Now, Morris has passed the first hurdle to completely eliminate the representation for hundreds of thousands of Black voters in Louisiana's 6th Congressional District.

Despite Governor Landry's best attempts to confuse voters and suppress turnout in the upcoming May 16th elections, Democrats and Black voters are turning out at historic pace. Louisianans see the injustice, the prejudice, and the blatant power grab. And they're revolting.

_Written with Bruce Dickson._
President Trump lands in Beijing today for two days of talks with Xi Jinping for a summit originally scheduled for March before the U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran forced a postponement. Xi is hosting a wartime president whose military is stretched across two conflicts, whose allies are questioning American reliability, and whose attention is split in ways that give Beijing significant advantages going into the room.
It wasn't always this complicated. Trump's last visit to Beijing, in 2017, looked like a coronation: a state dinner at the[ Forbidden City](https://substack.com/redirect/817fd65b-0208-48ae-a47d-c028fc2dade0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), military bands, and the kind of imperial pageantry China reserves for leaders it wants to impress. Xi was betting that the spectacle would buy goodwill. Days later, Trump launched a trade war. From Beijing's perspective, it was a humiliating betrayal.
The U.S.-China relationship that exists today barely resembles the one from that 2017 visit.
Back then, American foreign policy ran on a working assumption that turned out to be completely wrong: bring China into the global economy, and it would gradually liberalize. Trade would accomplish what diplomacy couldn't. Beijing would eventually become what Deputy Secretary of State Robert Zoellick famously called a "[responsible stakeholder](https://substack.com/redirect/5bd82cd6-e4bd-4e0d-a7a5-a8905d58235a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" -- a rising power that plays by the rules because it benefits from them. That bet failed.
Today it's a contest over who controls the foundational infrastructure of the next century: semiconductors, artificial intelligence (AI), rare earth minerals, naval routes, supply chains, and cyberspace.
It's also worth remembering what didn't exist in 2017: no Russia-Ukraine war, no Iran war, no [AUKUS](https://substack.com/redirect/3e513dba-98d1-4f15-a4fc-8081d85b566e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (the trilateral security pact between the U.S., U.K., and Australia, built specifically to counter Chinese influence in the Indo-Pacific), no serious debate about Taiwan timelines. The world the U.S. is navigating today would have been difficult to imagine when Trump last visited Beijing.
China is also a fundamentally different country than it was nine years ago.
It now has the [world's largest navy by ship count](https://substack.com/redirect/e3edd2ce-fc2e-4af3-8821-f2e2b7e9ad46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- over 370 ships according to the Pentagon's own assessments, while the U.S. Navy is projected to shrink to 287. That gap is only going to widen: [China has an estimated 230 times the shipbuilding capacity of the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/0de7ee7a-247a-4661-835e-27cebf70ef3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
It has spent years building domestic semiconductor capacity after the U.S. moved to choke off its access to advanced chips -- and while it still trails the cutting edge, it's far less behind than Washington expected. It dominates the processing of rare earth minerals, which are essential to everything from EV motors to missile systems to radar, meaning that even when those minerals are mined elsewhere, they often still get refined in China. And it has spent years deepening trade relationships across Africa, Latin America, and Southeast Asia -- reducing its dependence on Western markets while building the kind of global influence that doesn't show up in a single trade deficit number.
None of this means China is winning outright. [Youth unemployment is high](https://substack.com/redirect/fb496d5c-45ed-48ce-a2ca-8adbd72ba97b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), growth has slowed, and capital has been leaving. The U.S. still leads at the frontier of AI research, still has superior carriers and combat-experienced forces, and still commands an alliance network China can't come close to matching. But the perception of leverage has shifted -- and in geopolitics, perception has a way of becoming reality. In 2017, America looked dominant but frustrated. In 2026, China looks patient while America looks overstretched, tied down in two overseas conflicts with allies wondering whether Washington's commitments still mean what they used to.
After a series of negotiations through 2025, both sides rolled back tariffs and reached agreements on[ rare earth access](https://substack.com/redirect/e4716f12-8d72-4ca6-91cd-32c27713dc1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that China has since been slow to honor. The trade relationship is stabilizing on paper, but underneath, the leverage battle is still very much ongoing.
# **What to Watch For**
Talks begin Thursday and run through Friday. China is expected to announce purchases of Boeing aircraft, U.S. agricultural goods, and energy -- the transactional sweeteners designed to make the summit look like a win for Trump. Two new trade mechanisms may also be announced: a [Board of Trade and a Board of Investment](https://substack.com/redirect/52d46088-d8c8-4359-b985-d1d3663b8227?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Officials acknowledge these will require substantial subsequent work before they mean anything. Watch for them being spun as bigger than they are. China agreed to buy more U.S. agricultural products in both 2019 and 2025 and didn't fully follow through either time.
Elon Musk and Tim Cook are among more than a dozen top executives invited to join the delegation. Both have enormous business exposure in China. Apple is arguably the most entangled American company in the relationship, with manufacturing, supply chains, market access, and labor all running through Beijing's goodwill. Their presence signals this is as much a commerce trip as a diplomacy trip. It also gives Xi additional leverage, because both men have personal incentives to see the relationship stabilized on terms Beijing prefers.

# **The Tariff Wars**
Trump's original theory was to hit China with tariffs, and Beijing would have no choice but to make structural concessions. It didn't work that way.
When Trump launched the [trade war in 2018](https://substack.com/redirect/8de61189-71c2-45b2-a0b9-829884249b5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), China retaliated hard, targeting American agriculture, soybeans, and manufacturing in states that mattered politically. But the more consequential response was China's adaptation. China rerouted manufacturing through Vietnam, Mexico, and ASEAN intermediaries, deepened trade relationships across the Global South, and accelerated domestic production. Products technically stopped being "Made in China" while still depending heavily on Chinese inputs. The tariffs didn't hurt China as much as expected.

The agriculture numbers tell the story: Chinese purchases of U.S. [soybeans](https://substack.com/redirect/7154c7b3-9407-4534-a9a6-cab5a150bead?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dropped dramatically in 2025, pivoting instead to Brazil and Argentina. Although it resumed buying some American soybeans after the Trump-Xi meeting in South Korea in late 2025, it has yet to live up to its full commitment. All U.S. agricultural exports to China were down 53 percent in the first seven months of 2025 compared to the year before. It's almost a carbon copy of what happened in Trump's first term, when the value of U.S. soybean exports to China collapsed from $14 billion in 2016 to $3.1 billion in 2018. China ran the same playbook and it worked again.
Trump also overreached legally. In his second term, he imposed sweeping global tariffs using emergency powers under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), which the Supreme Court ruled he didn't have that authority to do.
As a result of the U.S.-China trade war, the [U.S. trade deficit with China](https://substack.com/redirect/cc2ec666-b6e7-4f68-890a-a3849c9983e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dropped from $375 billion in 2017 to $202 billion in 2025. But those numbers are deceiving because much of China's exports to the US have been rerouted through other countries. The total trade deficit of the U.S. rose from $792 billion in 2017 to $1.2 trillion last year. The Chinese share of that overall deficit is less, but the deficit continues to grow...

[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

The Trump administration just bypassed Congress to sneak through an $8.5
BILLION arms deal for Israel and Gulf states. Buried in that deal is
nearly a billion dollars’ worth of Advanced Precision Kill Weapon Systems
for Israel.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38226?source=email-20260513&t=1011&akid=10726%2E5885482%2EfrRAMk ]Headline: Trump rebuked for bypassing congress with $8.6 billion
weapons sale to israel and gulf allies.

The sale includes TEN THOUSAND of these deadly, offensive weapons. 10,000
more opportunities for Israel to kill with impunity, all with U.S.-made
weaponry.

We can’t let this happen – not in our name. Bernie is calling on the U.S.
to stop ALL weapons sales to Israel and he needs all of us with him.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38226?source=email-20260513&t=1012&akid=10726%2E5885482%2EfrRAMk ]Tell Congress: Follow Bernie’s lead and block this sale NOW. Click here
to send your message.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38226?source=email-20260513&t=1013&akid=10726%2E5885482%2EfrRAMk ]ADD YOUR NAME

Thanks to massive public outcry, the tide is turning on U.S. military
support for Israel. Last month, after Bernie introduced a resolution to
halt yet another weapons sale to Israel, most of the Democratic party
stood with him. Only seven Democrats voted no. It’s a sea change, and
Bernie is not stopping there.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38226?source=email-20260513&t=1014&akid=10726%2E5885482%2EfrRAMk ]Bernie tweet: It is time for the U.S. to end military aid to Israel.
But we're not going to wait 10 years to do it. The time to stop arming
Netanyahu and hold him accountable for his crimes against humanity is NOW.

That’s why the Trump administration went around Congress to fast-track
this deal – hoping it could quietly push it through without the public
noticing.

Let’s be clear: the Israeli government does not need more precision kill
systems – it needs accountability. Every new weapon shipment makes our
government complicit in ongoing war crimes. This sale is a death sentence
for innocent people, funded by U.S. taxpayer dollars.

But Bernie is not backing down, and neither are we. Our Revolution members
have sent thousands of emails calling on Congress to stop the endless
supply of U.S. weapons to Israel, and thanks to that pressure, the dam is
breaking. But if we stay quiet now, that courage could vanish under a tide
of lobbyist money and back-room deals.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38226?source=email-20260513&t=1015&akid=10726%2E5885482%2EfrRAMk ]Take action now: Click here to demand that your members of Congress
block these new deadly weapons for Israel.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38226?source=email-20260513&t=1016&akid=10726%2E5885482%2EfrRAMk ]ADD YOUR NAME

This is the moment to show our movement’s power, to stand arm in arm with
Bernie and demand an end to U.S. complicity in Israel’s violence. We can
stop this. But only if we all raise our voices right now.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | The financial establishment is telling you everything is "fine." | It’s not. name: John Papola, Dad Saves America
subject: Our boys are in crisis
body:
I want to be honest with you about something I've been wrestling with as a dad.
---
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e13198463/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvM2ZVa0h6WGN6Sg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA1MTM/LbmNsUEVYSUdBdg/qP2hpZHM9bmNLS2tTbzdXRjhZNU1scw/gagSliA/s5ra4e2a46b)

[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
Patriot,

I want to be honest with you about something I've been wrestling with as a dad.

A while back, I sat down with my son and tried to give him some simple dating advice, the kind my dad gave me. Make the first move. Don't end up in the friend zone. Take the initiative.

His response stopped me cold.

_**"Dad, you don't understand. I can't just do that."**_

He wasn't being difficult. He was telling me the truth about the world he's growing up in. And it broke my heart.

I recently sat down with psychoanalyst Erica Komisar for one of the most eye-opening conversations I've ever had on Dad Saves America. What she shared was both alarming and clarifying.

**Here's what's happening to our sons:**

**Schools are failing them.** The education system has been redesigned around the way girls learn. Boys are biologically wired differently. And when they can't adapt, they fall behind academically, develop stress disorders, get labeled as "problems," and carry that stigma for years.

**The culture has made them afraid.** Gen Z boys came of age against the backdrop of the #MeToo movement, where they are told that masculinity itself is toxic. The result is that young men are genuinely frightened of women, of being accused, of taking initiative, and of being themselves.

**They've been stripped of their role.** When we empowered women, we didn't replace what we removed for men. Without an identity or a role model, many of them retreat to their bedrooms, to screens, down online rabbit holes, _and some into deeply destructive ideologies._

Erica put it plainly: "Men without their identity are lost."

But she also said something that gave me hope: _this is fixable_.

Not by the government, the school system, or the culture.

**By Dads!**

That's exactly why _Dad Saves America_ exists, and why your support today matters so much. [You can help us reach more fathers who are ready to answer the call by donating today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
[**Donate**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
It’s no wonder that teen suicide and mental illness are climbing.

A generation of young men is adrift without purpose, direction, or the father figures they desperately need.

_Dad Saves America_ is a project of the Emergent Order Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Our mission is simple: _help men become the Dads they were created to be_. Fatherhood is the greatest opportunity you will ever have to make a positive impact.

We're here to help you rise to that calling and to build a growing movement of men who do the same.

Every week, we produce deep dive interviews, sharp commentary, and mini-documentaries with some of the most important voices in America — people like Jonathan Haidt, Dr. Drew, Bret Weinstein, and Erica Komisar — all through the lens of fatherhood.

After years of making this show, I've come to believe that the crisis our boys are living through is real.

But I’ve also discovered how to address this crisis directly.

**The answer is fathers. Present, engaged, intentional fathers who understand their sons’ needs and have the knowledge and courage to provide for them.**

When a boy has a father who models healthy masculinity and teaches him how to take initiative, handle rejection, and be resilient, that boy has a fighting chance.

Without it, the odds are stacked against him.

I don't say the name of this show lightly. **Dads really can save America**. But only if we show up.

That’s why I’m asking you to show up for this mission. [Make a donation today and help us put this content in front of every father in America who needs it.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
[**Donate**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
Since launching in 2022, we've published over 250 episodes, earned more than 485,000 subscribers, and logged over 50 million total views.

Men are hungry for this content. As one viewer put it.
_**"The way modern society is right now, we need more creators like these who aren't afraid to stand up for men and dads and prove masculinity is healthy and does not have to be toxic."**_
That's why we do this work. And that's why we need you to help us build something, one episode, one father, one family at a time.

[Please make a tax-deductible donation to Dad Saves America today. Every dollar goes toward producing the content that is waking up fathers across America.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
[**Donate $10**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[**Donate $35**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[**Donate $50**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[**Donate $100**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[**Donate $250**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[**Donate $500**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[**Donate $1000**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[**Donate Any Other Amount**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
The future of our boys depends on what we do right now.

For our sons,

John Papola
Co-Founder & CEO, Emergent Order Foundation
Host of _Dad Saves America_

## Defend the Courts: Virtual Phonebanks
---
| With less than one week until Election Day, the finish line is in sight and every conversation with a voter matters.
Only 8.7% of Georgians have cast a ballot so far. That means there are still thousands of voters who need reminders about what's on the ballot - including the critical Georgia Supreme Court and Court of Appeals races that will help shape the future of our state.
That's why we're continuing our voter outreach efforts through Election Day with phonebank volunteer opportunities! Whether you can help for an hour or an evening, your time can make a real impact in reaching voters before May 19th.

Derek,
What Trump and the GOP are doing to Social Security is causing chaos.
They have closed offices, cut staff, and made it harder for seniors to get help over the phone. **Now, they are pushing a plan that could result in hundreds of thousands of people losing their benefits.**
Their goal is simple: break Social Security, run it dry, and sell it for scrap.
Not on my watch.
I’m working as hard as I can in the Senate to fight back against these Social Security cuts – including by reintroducing my Billionaires Income Tax Act, which would make the ultrawealthy pay their fair share in taxes and allow us to keep our promise to seniors.
