Americans are obsessed with protein right now.

Protein shakes. Protein bars. Protein chips. Protein in everything.

And listen -- I'm not mad about it.

Protein is one of the most powerful tools we have for changing body composition, improving metabolism, building lean muscle, and staying full in a world that seems designed to keep you hungry.

But here's the problem...

Most people still don't understand what protein actually is.

Or more importantly:

**Not all protein sources are the same.**
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=197221141&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3MjIxMTQxLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg2OTE3MjgsImV4cCI6MTc4MTI4MzcyOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.AfR5KC0NhySXtUGFTrd5_DPN3HiMP-Li40Z5nlQvgwo)
If you want to eat like an athlete, think like a bodybuilder or physique model, and feel like a healthy human again...

You need to understand this simple truth:

Protein is not just a number.

_**Protein is a dial.**_

Let's break that down.

**Why Protein Matters**

Protein is the most satiating macronutrient.
That means it keeps you full longer than carbs or fat.

If you've ever felt like you're stuck on the "crab train"...

Always snacking. Always hungry. Always circling the pantry like a raccoon at midnight...

Protein is your exit ramp.

It helps with:

* Appetite control
* Muscle maintenance (especially as we age)
* Fat loss and re-composition
* Blood sugar stability
* Recovery from training
* Hormone signaling

Protein is the foundation.
But the _**source**_**** is where the real story begins.

**Animal Protein vs Plant Protein: The Full Story Matters**

There's a lot of noise today about plant-based diets. I'm not here to throw tomatoes at anyone. Plants have a role -- especially for fiber, antioxidants, and microbiome diversity.

But when it comes to protein...

Animal proteins are simply different.

**Animal Protein Advantages**

Animal proteins tend to be:

* More bioavailable (your body absorbs more of it)
* Complete amino acid profiles
* Higher in leucine (the muscle-building trigger amino acid)
* More nutrient dense per bite

That's why athletes, bodybuilders, and people trying to get lean almost always anchor their nutrition with animal protein.

**Plant Protein Reality Check**

Plant proteins often come with:

* Lower protein density per serving
* More carbohydrates
* More digestive burden (especially legumes)
* Incomplete amino acid profiles unless combined

And here's the big one...

You usually need to eat a _lot more volume_ of plant food to match the protein in animal food.
That matters.

Because many people today are dealing with:

* IBS
* bloating
* gut inflammation
* food sensitivities
* chronic digestive stress

So, telling someone to "just eat more beans" is not always helpful. Sometimes the answer is: **Eat a smaller amount of a higher-yield protein source.** That's coaching.

**Protein Density: A Simple Comparison**

All values below are based on **100g uncooked portions** :

**Chicken Breast (Lean Classic)**

* 165 calories
* 23g protein
* 0g carbs
* 3g fat

Chicken is the king of lean re-composition.
High protein, low fat, easy dial for fat loss.

**Salmon (Performance + Omega-3 Power)**

* 182 calories
* 22g protein
* 0g carbs
* 10g fat

Salmon is protein plus brain fuel.
A little higher fat, but elite nutrient density.
This is the "strong and healthy" protein source.

**Eggs (Nature 's Multivitamin)**

* 155 calories
* 13g protein
* 1g carbs
* 11g fat

Eggs are amazing... but they're fattier. That's not bad. It just means:

Eggs are a different dial setting.

More maintenance, more strength season, less "cutting phase."

**Tofu (Plant-Based Example)**

* 76 calories
* 8g protein
* 2g carbs
* 5g fat

Tofu can work, but notice the difference:

To match the protein in chicken... You'd need almost **3 times the amount**. That's a lot more volume and digestion.

**The Bodybuilder Secret: Protein Is a Dial**

This is one of my favorite coaching truths:

Bodybuilders don't just "eat protein." They select protein like an artist selects paint. Because protein sources come with different fat levels, calorie density, and satiety.

**Lean Protein Dial (Fat Loss + Re-composition)**

Choose:

* Chicken breast
* Turkey
* White fish
* Shrimp
* Ahi tuna

Example: Ahi tuna has **29g protein** with only **130 calories** per 100g.

That's pure efficiency.

**Higher-Fat Protein Dial (Strength + Maintenance)**

Choose:

* Ribeye
* Whole eggs
* Salmon
* Ground beef

These support hormones, recovery, and strength. But if your goal is fat loss? You may need to turn the dial leaner.

**Protein and Hunger: The Most Underrated Tool**

If someone tells me: "Coach, I'm always hungry..." My first question is almost always:

**How much real protein are you eating?**

Protein shuts down cravings. It stabilizes appetite hormones. It helps you stop feeling like you need a snack every two hours. Most people aren't overeating because they're broken...

They're overeating because they're under-proteined.

**The Coaching Takeaway: Choose the Right Protein for the Season**

Here's the Fast.Eat.Live. mindset:

You don't need perfection. You need awareness.

Ask yourself:

* Am I trying to lean out? -> go leaner
* Am I training hard? -> add fattier performance proteins
* Is my gut struggling? -> choose high-yield animal proteins over heavy legumes
* Do I feel hungry all day? -> increase protein at breakfast and lunch

_**Protein is a dial**_. Turn it with intention.

**Final Thought**

In a world full of confusion...Protein is one of the simplest anchors you can build your health around. But don't just count grams. Understand the source. Understand the yield. Understand the dial. Because when you do...
You stop eating like the average American... And you start eating like someone who's finally in control.

If you're "always hungry," you're probably not broken--you're just under-proteined and on the wrong dial. | | | May 13 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Americans are obsessed with protein right now. Protein shakes. Protein bars. Protein chips. Protein in everything. And listen -- I'm not mad about it. Protein is one of the most powerful tools we have for changing body composition, improving metabolism, building lean muscle, and staying full in a world that seems designed to keep you hungry. But here's the problem... Most people still don't understand what protein actually is. Or more importantly: Not all protein sources are the same. If you want to eat like an athlete, think like a bodybuilder or physique model, and feel like a healthy human again... You need to understand this simple truth: Protein is not just a number. Protein is a dial. Let's break that down. Why Protein Matters Protein is the most satiating macronutrient. That means it keeps you full longer than carbs or fat. If you've ever felt like you're stuck on the "crab train"... Always snacking. Always hungry. Always circling the pantry like a raccoon at midnight... Protein is your exit ramp. It helps with: Appetite control Muscle maintenance (especially as we age) Fat loss and re-composition Blood sugar stability Recovery from training Hormone signaling Protein is the foundation. But the source** is where the real story begins. Animal Protein vs Plant Protein: The Full Story Matters There's a lot of noise today about plant-based diets. I'm not here to throw tomatoes at anyone. Plants have a role -- especially for fiber, antioxidants, and microbiome diversity. But when it comes to protein... Animal proteins are simply different. Animal Protein Advantages Animal proteins tend to be: More bioavailable (your body absorbs more of it) Complete amino acid profiles Higher in leucine (the muscle-building trigger amino acid) More nutrient dense per bite That's why athletes, bodybuilders, and people trying to get lean almost always anchor their nutrition with animal protein. Plant Protein Reality Check Plant proteins often come with: Lower protein density per serving More carbohydrates More digestive burden (especially legumes) Incomplete amino acid profiles unless combined And here's the big one... You usually need to eat a lot more volume of plant food to match the protein in animal food. That matters. Because many people today are dealing with: IBS bloating gut inflammation food sensitivities chronic digestive stress So, telling someone to "just eat more beans" is not always helpful. Sometimes the answer is: Eat a smaller amount of a higher-yield protein source. That's coaching. Protein Density: A Simple Comparison All values below are based on 100g uncooked portions : Chicken Breast (Lean Classic) 165 calories 23g protein 0g carbs 3g fat Chicken is the king of lean re-composition. High protein, low fat, easy dial for fat loss. Salmon (Performance + Omega-3 Power) 182 calories 22g protein 0g carbs 10g fat Salmon is protein plus brain fuel. A little higher fat, but elite nutrient density. This is the "strong and healthy" protein source. Eggs (Nature 's Multivitamin) 155 calories 13g protein 1g carbs 11g fat Eggs are amazing... but they're fattier. That's not bad. It just means: Eggs are a different dial setting. More maintenance, more strength season, less "cutting phase." Tofu (Plant-Based Example) 76 calories 8g protein 2g carbs 5g fat Tofu can work, but notice the difference: To match the protein in chicken... You'd need almost 3 times the amount. That's a lot more volume and digestion. The Bodybuilder Secret: Protein Is a Dial This is one of my favorite coaching truths: Bodybuilders don't just "eat protein." They select protein like an artist selects paint. Because protein sources come with different fat levels, calorie density, and satiety. Lean Protein Dial (Fat Loss + Re-composition) Choose: Chicken breast Turkey White fish Shrimp Ahi tuna Example: Ahi tuna has 29g protein with only 130 calories per 100g. That's pure efficiency. Higher-Fat Protein Dial (Strength + Maintenance) Choose: Ribeye Whole eggs Salmon Ground beef These support hormones, recovery, and strength. But if your goal is fat loss? You may need to turn the dial leaner. Protein and Hunger: The Most Underrated Tool If someone tells me: "Coach, I'm always hungry..." My first question is almost always: How much real protein are you eating? Protein shuts down cravings. It stabilizes appetite hormones. It helps you stop feeling like you need a snack every two hours. Most people aren't overeating because they're broken... They're overeating because they're under-proteined. The Coaching Takeaway: Choose the Right Protein for the Season Here's the Fast.Eat.Live. mindset: You don't need perfection. You need awareness. Ask yourself: Am I trying to lean out? -> go leaner Am I training hard? -> add fattier performance proteins Is my gut struggling? -> choose high-yield animal proteins over heavy legumes Do I feel hungry all day? -> increase protein at breakfast and lunch Protein is a dial. Turn it with intention. Final Thought In a world full of confusion...Protein is one of the simplest anchors you can build your health around. But don't just count grams. Understand the source. Understand the yield. Understand the dial. Because when you do... You stop eating like the average American... And you start eating like someone who's finally in control. That's .** By Coach Scott Jansen Fast.Eat.Live. Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sole opinion of the writer. Always consult a physician before starting an exercise or diet regime. ---
| |
---
| | | Dear Peter,
---
May is Mental Health Awareness Month and in these unusually chaotic times, it's a gentle reminder to take a moment for some good old-fashioned self-care. Preferably, in the nearest forest—and science shows why. “We evolved in relationship with the trees,” says Susan Abookire, assistant professor at Harvard Medical School. “There is no one pharmaceutical or precision medicine tool that could ever have the broad benefits of a forest.” Especially redwood forests. Redwoods fill the forest air with terpenes, an aromatic compound the trees emit to fend off harmful fungi and hungry insects. But terpenes are good for us humans. They don’t just smell great (woodsy, piney, a hint of citrus)—when we breathe them in, they interact with receptors in our brain to reduce anxiety. It’s like free aromatherapy. Plus when you hike, run, or bike through the redwoods, your brain pumps out mood-boosting chemicals like endorphins and serotonin, a little reward for your effort.
---
---
Beyond chemistry, trees work on us in quieter ways. While screens constantly clamor for our attention, the forest pulls our focus back to the natural world. We become absorbed in the petals of a wildflower, the sweep of a redwood bough. Our thoughts slow down. Preferably, in the nearest forest—and science shows why. “We evolved in relationship with the trees,” says Susan Abookire, assistant professor at Harvard Medical School. “There is no one pharmaceutical or precision medicine tool that could ever have the broad benefits of a forest.” Especially redwood forests. Redwoods fill the forest air with terpenes, an aromatic compound the trees emit to fend off harmful fungi and hungry insects. But terpenes are good for us humans. They don’t just smell great (woodsy, piney, a hint of citrus)—when we breathe them in, they interact with receptors in our brain to reduce anxiety. It’s like free aromatherapy. Plus when you hike, run, or bike through the redwoods, your brain pumps out mood-boosting chemicals like endorphins and serotonin, a little reward for your effort. After the Palisades fire California has found another novel way to set taxpayer money on fire, and this time the fuel is diapers.
Gov. Gavin Newsom rolled out the Golden State Start program right before Mother's Day. The pitch was simple and hard to argue with: **[give free diapers to newborns so low-income families don't have to scramble.](https://substack.com/redirect/6fccc40e-3621-4086-abf4-70bb8be4ff4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/6fccc40e-3621-4086-abf4-70bb8be4ff4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The state is spending $20 million--$7.4 million already approved, another $12.5 million baked into the next budget--to deliver roughly 40 million diapers to about 100,000 babies. That works out to 400 diapers per kid. _(The Capitalist 's independent research with new parents put the average daily diapers used by a newborn at between 10 and 12 per day)_ so that basically means that the State of California will cover between 33 and 40 days worth of diapers.
It's the sort of proposal that all but the most cold hearted person could get behind. Diapers for new babies are a size-able cost to any budget and making things just that little bit easier for low income families with a newborn is probably a good thing.
We'll ignore the fact that in the land of EV's and "Climate Change" (something that California is always so keen on) 40 million disposable diapers is hardly a "green proposal," and seems a little out of character but their heart seems to be in the right place so we'll let it slide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/09ddbc90-e499-49de-a571-42e512dccb6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Steve Hilton, the Republican running for governor already did, he stood in a Target store and better yet he did it on camera.
[| | | | | Steve Hilton
---
@SteveHiltonx
How much are diapers at Target compared to Gavin Newsom's government diapers paid for by YOUR taxes? We went to take a look:
| 3:03 PM * May 10, 2026 * 875K Views1.72K Replies * 16.5K Reposts * 55.1K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/816873d9-f3bc-49a3-9d96-2ad6f458f743?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The state is paying 50 cents per diaper through this program. A box on the shelf at Target runs $0.16 cents each. More than three times cheaper. Not even Costco prices--just straight off the shelf retail. Hilton wasn't cherry-picking some obscure brand. He was holding up the kind of everyday pack parents actually buy. The program doesn't beat the store. It gets crushed by it.
So the Taxpayers are literally getting gouged and the cost of the diapers are 3 times what you would pay in store.
_**Well thats not good, kinda makes you want to ask who in the hell is running this program????**_
We're so glad you asked.
The taxpayer money doesn't go straight to parents or even straight to stores. Nothing so simple. It flows through a Los Angeles nonprofit called Baby2Baby.
The group gets the contract, handles distribution through hospitals, and presumably pockets whatever margin exists between what the state of California pays them and whatever cost they can source diapers for in bulk (and it's not out of this world to think that that bulk cost will likely be lower than the $0.16 cents you pay retail at Target.)
_**So who runs Baby2Baby? More to the point, how did they get such a deal?**_
Again, we're so glad you asked.
The co-CEO of Baby2Baby since 2011 is **[Norah Weinstein](https://substack.com/redirect/bf60c258-8bad-4fab-af6e-7aab91d96472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **who also sits on the board of the California Partners Project.
_**Who founded the California Partners Project?**_
You're really good at asking questions, do you know that?
The California Partners Project was **[co-founded and run by Jennifer Siebel Newsom,](https://substack.com/redirect/bf60c258-8bad-4fab-af6e-7aab91d96472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (That would be the Gavin Newsom's wife.)
The icing on the cake? The California Partners Project **[helped facilitate the partnership](https://substack.com/redirect/bf60c258-8bad-4fab-af6e-7aab91d96472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **with Baby2Baby.
You don't need a conspiracy board to see the overlap. It's right there in the org charts!
Critics have been loud about it. One congressional candidate put it bluntly[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/6fccc40e-3621-4086-abf4-70bb8be4ff4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[insinuating that](https://substack.com/redirect/6fccc40e-3621-4086-abf4-70bb8be4ff4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Newsom is laundering taxpayer dollars to a nonprofit run by his wife's friend.
This is how it works in California. Democrats spot a real problem--parents struggling to keep babies dry--and turn it into a government program that costs more than the private market while routing cash through politically connected middlemen.
The idea of helping with diapers is admirable. No serious person wants newborns sitting in soiled clothes because the family budget is stretched. But the execution here is pure grift. Taxpayers foot the bill at triple the retail rate so insiders can administer it, take their cut, then hand out the product with the state's name attached. The families get the diapers. The connected nonprofit gets the contract. Everyone else gets the invoice and if they complain, well, "You must just hate babies!"
Let's talk real-world consequences, because that's what matters to the people writing the checks to pay for this. California families are already getting hammered on basics. Gas is more expensive because of special state blends and surcharges. Housing costs are insane. Groceries keep climbing. Now add this: the state takes your money, inflates the price of something you could buy cheaper yourself, and calls it compassion. If the goal was simply to make sure babies have diapers, the cheapest way would have been to cut parents a check or give them a voucher for Target or Walmart.
Instead, Sacramento invented a bureaucracy, hired a nonprofit with ties to the first family, and paid premium rates. The difference--those extra 34 cents per diaper--multiplies across 40 million units. We did the math. Its roughly $13.6 million bucks. That means that **two thirds of the tax money taken from California taxpayers** doesn't buy diapers for underprivileged kids at all, it lines the pockets of Jennifer Siebel Newsom's buddy's non-profit. That's real money. Money that could have stayed in family budgets or gone to actual infrastructure (**[not high speed rail though, we beg you!](https://substack.com/redirect/a5fda862-3c61-4c1c-bd75-0ea8e3be058d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**)
This isn't a diaper bill, this is a donation to a first family connected non-profit that just happens to hand out a few diapers on the side!
And this isn't an isolated "oops." It's pattern recognition. Democrats see a human need and immediately build a program around it that benefits the political class more than the intended recipients. They did it with the aforementioned high-speed rail that never arrived. They did it with **[homelessness initiatives](https://substack.com/redirect/dd51a4ab-9bd1-4b7b-be45-c28f293a1476?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that produce more tents than housing. They do it with every feel-good handout. Everything requires a layer of connected consultants, connected nonprofits, and connected executives. The poor get the surface-level help lip service. The grifters get the steady revenue stream and make out like bandits and the taxpayers, well they get the bill and a lecture about caring.
* * *
* * *
**[Become a paid subscriber today and access the Live Capitalist chat](https://substack.com/redirect/09ddbc90-e499-49de-a571-42e512dccb6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Have a view? Let us know!](https://substack.com/redirect/032f0ee0-53e1-4b89-a517-408fbc3dad79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Baby2Baby isn't some fly-by-night operation. It's been around since 2011. **[But there are questions about how it operates](https://substack.com/redirect/bf60c258-8bad-4fab-af6e-7aab91d96472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and when it lands a $20 million no-bid-style deal tied to the governor's inner circle, the optics rot. Hilton called it exactly what it looks like: a scheme that benefits cronies instead of letting people keep more of their own cash and decide how to spend it.
Newsom's office hasn't exactly rushed out a detailed defense. They've promoted the program as "first-in-the-nation," which is true if you measure by novelty and not by efficiency. But novelty doesn't justify the markup. If the state wanted to move product faster or reach more people, it could have partnered with big-box retailers for bulk distribution at actual market rates. Instead, it chose the path that keeps the money circulating inside the familiar network.
In a statement **[Newsom's office told Fox News](https://substack.com/redirect/6fccc40e-3621-4086-abf4-70bb8be4ff4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** _" As previously mentioned, the actual cost per diaper breakdown equates to about $.15 per diaper, not $.50."_ The statement is basically worth the contents of a soiled diaper because their own numbers prove the cost.
**400 diapers per kid x 100,000 kids is 40 million diapers**
**$20 million dollars ÷ 40 million diapers = Fifty cents a diaper.**
As a commentator put it: **["Math always wins."](https://substack.com/redirect/816873d9-f3bc-49a3-9d96-2ad6f458f743?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** And the math here is embarrassing. Fifty cents for a government diaper versus sixteen cents for a retail diaper. No amount of press-release spin changes the price tag on the shelf.
The practical impact on regular people is straightforward. Working parents in California already operate with razor-thin margins. Every extra dollar sucked out in taxes or inflated program costs is a dollar not spent on rent, food, or gas. The same politicians who brag about helping families keep jacking up the cost of living everywhere else. This program doesn't fix affordability. It mocks it.
**This is the California model in miniature:**
1. **Identify a problem.**
2. **Create a well-intentioned program.**
3. **Hand it to friends and allies who run nonprofits.**
4. **Pay above-market rates.**
5. **Call it progress.**
6. **Watch the costs balloon and the results underwhelm.**

Meanwhile, the people footing the bill--middle-class families, small-business owners, anyone who pays California taxes--get another reminder that government compassion is expensive, inefficient and shady.
The diaper program isn't going to bankrupt the state by itself. California's budget is already a multi-hundred-billion-dollar machine running on autopilot. But it's a perfect symptom. When even something as basic and uncontroversial as baby diapers becomes an opportunity for **triple-cost procurement** and **insider contracts,** you know the system is rigged against the taxpayer. The admirable goal--babies shouldn't go without diapers--gets lost in the grift. What's left is another line item where Sacramento proves it can take a straightforward need and make it more complicated and more costly than it has any right to be.
At the end of the day, parents just want dry babies and lower bills. They don't need a branded government initiative run through a politically wired nonprofit to get there. They need the state to stop inventing expensive ways to do what the market already does cheaper. Until that changes,
California will keep discovering new ways to burn cash and call it leadership.
Diapers today. Something else tomorrow. The fire stays lit.
The taxpayers keep paying.

(And his wife knows all about it) | | | May 13 | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- The Capitalist exists because of you, and we want to hear from you! After the Palisades fire California has found another novel way to set taxpayer money on fire, and this time the fuel is diapers. Gov. Gavin Newsom rolled out the Golden State Start program right before Mother's Day. The pitch was simple and hard to argue with: The state is spending $20 million--$7.4 million already approved, another $12.5 million baked into the next budget--to deliver roughly 40 million diapers to about 100,000 babies. That works out to 400 diapers per kid. (The Capitalist 's independent research with new parents put the average daily diapers used by a newborn at between 10 and 12 per day) so that basically means that the State of California will cover between 33 and 40 days worth of diapers. It's the sort of proposal that all but the most cold hearted person could get behind. Diapers for new babies are a size-able cost to any budget and making things just that little bit easier for low income families with a newborn is probably a good thing. We'll ignore the fact that in the land of EV's and "Climate Change" (something that California is always so keen on) 40 million disposable diapers is hardly a "green proposal," and seems a little out of character but their heart seems to be in the right place so we'll let it slide. | | ---|---|--- However, as this is deep blue California, let us dig a little deeper shall we? You know, on the off chance that maybe theres more to this than meets the eye. Oh wait, we don't have to. Sponsored by: | | ---|---|--- Everyone's hunting for the next Unicorn. The type of "category disruptor" that grows fast and turns early believers into big winners. 59,000+ investors think that could be one of those rare finds. Americans spend 4 1⁄2 hours on their phones daily, and Mode Mobile is monetizing that screentime. With and 32,481% revenue growth, Mode's EarnPhone is turning smartphones into income generating assets. Their previous raises sold out, and the company is now offering pre-IPO shares at $0.50/share with up to 20% bonus, exclusive to early investors. Being early is everything, and this window is still open. Steve Hilton, the Republican running for governor already did, he stood in a Target store and better yet he did it on camera. The state is paying 50 cents per diaper through this program. A box on the shelf at Target runs $0.16 cents each. More than three times cheaper. Not even Costco prices--just straight off the shelf retail. Hilton wasn't cherry-picking some obscure brand. He was holding up the kind of everyday pack parents actually buy. The program doesn't beat the store. It gets crushed by it. So the Taxpayers are literally getting gouged and the cost of the diapers are 3 times what you would pay in store. Well thats not good, kinda makes you want to ask who in the hell is running this program???? We're so glad you asked. The taxpayer money doesn't go straight to parents or even straight to stores. Nothing so simple. It flows through a Los Angeles nonprofit called Baby2Baby. The group gets the contract, handles distribution through hospitals, and presumably pockets whatever margin exists between what the state of California pays them and whatever cost they can source diapers for in bulk (and it's not out of this world to think that that bulk cost will likely be lower than the $0.16 cents you pay retail at Target.) So who runs Baby2Baby? More to the point, how did they get such a deal? Again, we're so glad you asked. The co-CEO of Baby2Baby since 2011 is who also sits on the board of the California Partners Project. Who founded the California Partners Project? You're really good at asking questions, do you know that? The California Partners Project was (That would be the Gavin Newsom's wife.) The icing on the cake? The California Partners Project with Baby2Baby. You don't need a conspiracy board to see the overlap. It's right there in the org charts! Critics have been loud about it. One congressional candidate put it bluntly Newsom is laundering taxpayer dollars to a nonprofit run by his wife's friend. This is how it works in California. Democrats spot a real problem--parents struggling to keep babies dry--and turn it into a government program that costs more than the private market while routing cash through politically connected middlemen. The idea of helping with diapers is admirable. No serious person wants newborns sitting in soiled clothes because the family budget is stretched. But the execution here is pure grift. Taxpayers foot the bill at triple the retail rate so insiders can administer it, take their cut, then hand out the product with the state's name attached. The families get the diapers. The connected nonprofit gets the contract. Everyone else gets the invoice and if they complain, well, "You must just hate babies!" Let's talk real-world consequences, because that's what matters to the people writing the checks to pay for this. California families are already getting hammered on basics. Gas is more expensive because of special state blends and surcharges. Housing costs are insane. Groceries keep climbing. Now add this: the state takes your money, inflates the price of something you could buy cheaper yourself, and calls it compassion. If the goal was simply to make sure babies have diapers, the cheapest way would have been to cut parents a check or give them a voucher for Target or Walmart. Instead, Sacramento invented a bureaucracy, hired a nonprofit with ties to the first family, and paid premium rates. The difference--those extra 34 cents per diaper--multiplies across 40 million units. We did the math. Its roughly $13.6 million bucks. That means that two thirds of the tax money taken from California taxpayers doesn't buy diapers for underprivileged kids at all, it lines the pockets of Jennifer Siebel Newsom's buddy's non-profit. That's real money. Money that could have stayed in family budgets or gone to actual infrastructure () This isn't a diaper bill, this is a donation to a first family connected non-profit that just happens to hand out a few diapers on the side! And this isn't an isolated "oops." It's pattern recognition. Democrats see a human need and immediately build a program around it that benefits the political class more than the intended recipients. They did it with the aforementioned high-speed rail that never arrived. They did it with that produce more tents than housing. They do it with every feel-good handout. Everything requires a layer of connected consultants, connected nonprofits, and connected executives. The poor get the surface-level help lip service. The grifters get the steady revenue stream and make out like bandits and the taxpayers, well they get the bill and a lecture about caring. Baby2Baby isn't some fly-by-night operation. It's been around since 2011. and when it lands a $20 million no-bid-style deal tied to the governor's inner circle, the optics rot. Hilton called it exactly what it looks like: a scheme that benefits cronies instead of letting people keep more of their own cash and decide how to spend it. Newsom's office hasn't exactly rushed out a detailed defense. They've promoted the program as "first-in-the-nation," which is true if you measure by novelty and not by efficiency. But novelty doesn't justify the markup. If the state wanted to move product faster or reach more people, it could have partnered with big-box retailers for bulk distribution at actual market rates. Instead, it chose the path that keeps the money circulating inside the familiar network. In a statement " As previously mentioned, the actual cost per diaper breakdown equates to about $.15 per diaper, not $.50." The statement is basically worth the contents of a soiled diaper because their own numbers prove the cost. 400 diapers per kid x 100,000 kids is 40 million diapers $20 million dollars ÷ 40 million diapers = Fifty cents a diaper. As a commentator put it: And the math here is embarrassing. Fifty cents for a government diaper versus sixteen cents for a retail diaper. No amount of press-release spin changes the price tag on the shelf. The practical impact on regular people is straightforward. Working parents in California already operate with razor-thin margins. Every extra dollar sucked out in taxes or inflated program costs is a dollar not spent on rent, food, or gas. The same politicians who brag about helping families keep jacking up the cost of living everywhere else. This program doesn't fix affordability. It mocks it. This is the California model in miniature: 1. Identify a problem. 2. Create a well-intentioned program. 3. Hand it to friends and allies who run nonprofits. 4. Pay above-market rates. 5. Call it progress. 6. Watch the costs balloon and the results underwhelm. Meanwhile, the people footing the bill--middle-class families, small-business owners, anyone who pays California taxes--get another reminder that government compassion is expensive, inefficient and shady. The diaper program isn't going to bankrupt the state by itself. California's budget is already a multi-hundred-billion-dollar machine running on autopilot. But it's a perfect symptom. When even something as basic and uncontroversial as baby diapers becomes an opportunity for triple-cost procurement and insider contracts, you know the system is rigged against the taxpayer. The admirable goal--babies shouldn't go without diapers--gets lost in the grift. What's left is another line item where Sacramento proves it can take a straightforward need and make it more complicated and more costly than it has any right to be. At the end of the day, parents just want dry babies and lower bills. They don't need a branded government initiative run through a politically wired nonprofit to get there. They need the state to stop inventing expensive ways to do what the market already does cheaper. Until that changes, California will keep discovering new ways to burn cash and call it leadership. Diapers today. Something else tomorrow. The fire stays lit. The taxpayers keep paying. clean_body: | | | We’ll keep this quick, Peter: there’s less than one week left in Pennsylvania’s 3rd Congressional District primary, and Chris Rabb has a real shot to win — if we can keep organizing at full speed through Election Day. You’ve probably heard us talk about Chris already. He’s spent years in the Pennsylvania legislature fighting for affordable housing, healthcare, union jobs, taxing billionaires, and getting corporate money out of politics. Which, unsurprisingly, has made a lot of wealthy and powerful people nervous. As this race gets closer, billionaires, corporate-backed groups, and the Democratic establishment are scrambling behind closed doors to stop Chris — because they know he’s not going to Congress to make life easier for the people profiting off skyrocketing rents, poverty wages, and unaffordable healthcare. He’s going to fight for the people getting crushed by all of it. Corporate-backed outside groups are flooding this race with money, Peter, while political insiders are working overtime to stop Chris at every turn — and one super PAC backing his opponents was recently exposed for quietly receiving hundreds of thousands of dollars tied to AIPAC through what reporters described as a shell organization.1 make no mistake: they don’t flood a race with this kind of money unless they’re scared. People with money and power are trying to crush this campaign because they know exactly what’s at stake: whether working people elect someone who will actually fight for them — in Pennsylvania and everywhere else — or whether wealthy donors and political insiders keep deciding who holds power in this country. People are tired of politicians who campaign like fighters and then cave to wealthy donors the second things get politically inconvenient, Peter, which is exactly why we need leaders willing to stand with working people and fight for people over profit no matter who pushes back. Right now, our organizers are phonebanking, textbanking, knocking doors, and talking to voters across Northwest Philadelphia every single day. In a race this close, a few hundred conversations could decide the outcome. That’s not an exaggeration. And victories like this matter far beyond one district. They show working people everywhere that billionaire money and political insiders don’t always get the final say. In solidarity, Working Families Party P.S. Thank you for continuing to stand with our WFP champions, our movement, and the people fighting to build something better in communities that have been ignored, exploited, and pushed aside for far too long. This movement exists because people like you keep choosing solidarity over cynicism and people over profit. Source: 1\. , Drop Site News, April 23, 2026. Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Once a federally permissible source has contributed $5,000 in a calendar year, Outrage then Action PAC will transfer any amounts in excess of $5,000 to its non-contribution account. name: Freedom 250
subject: Join Us May 17th for Rededicate 250 on the National Mall!
body:
A once-in-a-generation gathering of prayer, praise & thanksgiving celebrating 250 years of God's blessings on America.
Join the White House and Speaker Johnson on the National Mall
The White House and Speaker Mike Johnson invite you to join them on the National Mall on Sunday, May 17th, 2026.
| [](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
---
The White House and Speaker Mike Johnson are personally inviting YOU to join them on the National Mall on Sunday, May 17th, 2026 to worship, pray, and rededicate America as One Nation Under God (see his letter below). On May 17, 1776, the Second Continental Congress held a day of "prayer, fasting, and humiliation" just weeks before declaring independence on July 4th. Now, exactly 250 years to the day, thousands of Americans will come together in our nation's capital to give thanks and to ask for his forgiveness, mercy, and guidance as we enter the next 250. Other special guests include Chris Tomlin, Jonathan Roumie, Eric Metaxes, Sec. Pete Hegseth, Bishop Robert Barron, and Dr. Ben Carson-as well as dozens of faith leaders and Christian performers (see the list below). [REGISTER & LEARN MORE HERE](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.) For any questions, email: [Rededicate250@WHO.eop.gov](mailto:Rededicate250@WHO.eop.gov). subject: We can’t leave the energy on May Day.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cori For Us
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a]
Peter,
This month, I was proud to rally in St. Louis with workers, coalition partners, and community members, and to stand at Washington University on International Workers’ Day, shoulder-to-shoulder with graduate workers, international students, and our movement family. It was a joy to show Hasan Piker how we do it in The Lou—demanding dignity, justice, and real power for everyday people.
And let me tell you something: the energy in that crowd? It wasn’t just powerful. It was righteous.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a]
I was proud to say what too many in power refuse to admit: higher education must serve the people. That means fully funding teachers and research. That means paying graduate workers real, livable wages. And that means protecting international students from Trump’s violent, dehumanizing immigration enforcement crackdown.
Because no one should be exploited for their labor, targeted for where they come from, or forced to live in fear just to learn, work, and survive...
I’m deeply grateful to Hasan for standing with us here in St. Louis, but this fight doesn’t end after one day. We can’t leave the energy there, Peter. It grows with every single person who chooses to step up.
Will you stand with us right now? Commit today to help us keep organizing, keep showing up, and keep fighting for workers, students, and families who are counting on us to deliver real change >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a]
We are up against powerful forces that want to silence this movement, that want to divide us, underpay us, deport us, and push us into the shadows. They see someone like me, fighting for the workers and families, and they are already doing whatever it takes to silence me and my movement.
But we’ve never backed down. And we’re not about to start now. Chip in today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a]
I need you in this fight.
In solidarity,
Cori
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260513_maydayrecap_act_a] Cori Bush is a pastor, nurse, survivor, and formerly unhoused single mother of two who knows what it means to struggle and what it means to rise .
As a Congresswoman, she has always shown up when it’s hardest: securing disaster relief, lowering insulin costs, and delivering millions for our communities.
Across St. Louis, families are being priced out and pushed out. Cori Bush is fighting back for affordable housing, fair wages, and utilities as a human right. Be part of this people-first movement. Visit CoriBush.org [https://www.coribush.org] to learn more.

name: Autism Health
subject: Join Us for Our Upcoming Autism Support Group
body:
** Join Us for Our Autism Support Group
------------------------------------------------------------

We invite you to join our upcoming Autism Support Group on Monday, May 18th at 5:00 PM PST for an evening of connection, encouragement, and shared experiences within the autism community.

This special gathering will include heartfelt testimonials from parents, expert opinions from professionals in the field, and meaningful conversations from families navigating autism and related neurological conditions. Whether you are seeking guidance, community, or simply a place where others understand your journey, this group is designed to provide support in a welcoming and compassionate environment.

Our Autism Support Group is a safe place for individuals and families impacted by autism to come together, learn from one another, and build lasting connections. No matter where you are on your journey, you are not alone.

Register using the link below to receive access details.

We look forward to connecting with you.
REGISTER HERE (https://autismhealth.com/support/?mc_cid=f755e35ee2&mc_eid=UNIQID)

AHS Recordings Now Available Online

Missed the Autism Health Summit or want to revisit your favorite presentations? We are excited to announce that the full 3-day recordings from the Autism Health Summit are now available for purchase online.

This year’s Summit featured an extraordinary lineup of physicians, researchers, advocates, and thought leaders discussing emerging science, integrative approaches, environmental factors, clinical insights, and practical strategies for individuals impacted by autism and neurological conditions. Now, you can access these powerful presentations from the comfort of your home and learn at your own pace.

We are offering two recording options:
• General Recordings for parents, caregivers, and community members
• Professional Track Recordings for medical professionals seeking to earn 10.5 CME credits

Whether you attended the conference in person or could not join us in San Diego, this is an incredible opportunity to gain access to valuable education and expert insight from the Autism Health Summit.
BUY HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=f755e35ee2&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Save the Date: Cocktails for A Cause
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=f755e35ee2&mc_eid=UNIQID

We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health Inc. on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA.

Sponsored by Cellular Performance Institute, this special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, inspiring presentations from featured speakers (to be announced), and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences.

Tickets are $85 per person, and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health Inc.’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions.

We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://givebutter.com/cocktails-4-a-cause?gbtid=a23a5433-a8ec-4114-9d95-978462f7661b&mc_cid=f755e35ee2&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Please Vote for the 2026 Author of the Year

We are honored to share that Tracy Slepcevic, Co-Founder and President of Autism Health Inc., has been nominated for the 2026 Author of the Year award through the International Impact Book Awards.

Tracy’s bestselling book, Warrior Mom: A Mother's Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism, has inspired and empowered families around the world through her heartfelt story of perseverance, faith, and determination as a mother navigating the autism journey. More than just a memoir, Warrior Mom has become a trusted guidebook for parents seeking hope, practical insight, and encouragement while advocating for their children.

The book has received praise from many respected voices, including the endorsement from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who described Warrior Mom as:
“An inspiring testimony to the miraculous power of maternal love.”

We would deeply appreciate your support in helping recognize Tracy’s impact and dedication to the autism community. Voting closes on August 31, 2026, and every vote makes a difference.

Learn more about Warrior Mom at: www.WarriorMom.com (https://track.pstmrk.it/3/www.warriormom.com%2F/b43o/NlXFAQ/AQ/d9ab1b08-585e-4ef6-a6db-da28c347b336/4/2tc4eMNHiy?mc_cid=f755e35ee2&mc_eid=UNIQID)
VOTE HERE (https://apply.internationalimpactbookawards.com/public-voting-form?mc_cid=f755e35ee2&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=f755e35ee2&mc_eid=UNIQID)

clean_body: Join Us for Our Autism Support Group We invite you to join our upcoming Autism Support Group on Monday, May 18th at 5:00 PM PST for an evening of connection, encouragement, and shared experiences within the autism community. This special gathering will include heartfelt testimonials from parents, expert opinions from professionals in the field, and meaningful conversations from families navigating autism and related neurological conditions. Whether you are seeking guidance, community, or simply a place where others understand your journey, this group is designed to provide support in a welcoming and compassionate environment. Our Autism Support Group is a safe place for individuals and families impacted by autism to come together, learn from one another, and build lasting connections. No matter where you are on your journey, you are not alone. Register using the link below to receive access details. We look forward to connecting with you. REGISTER HERE () AHS Recordings Now Available Online Missed the Autism Health Summit or want to revisit your favorite presentations? We are excited to announce that the full 3-day recordings from the Autism Health Summit are now available for purchase online. This year’s Summit featured an extraordinary lineup of physicians, researchers, advocates, and thought leaders discussing emerging science, integrative approaches, environmental factors, clinical insights, and practical strategies for individuals impacted by autism and neurological conditions. Now, you can access these powerful presentations from the comfort of your home and learn at your own pace. We are offering two recording options: • General Recordings for parents, caregivers, and community members • Professional Track Recordings for medical professionals seeking to earn 10.5 CME credits Whether you attended the conference in person or could not join us in San Diego, this is an incredible opportunity to gain access to valuable education and expert insight from the Autism Health Summit. BUY HERE () Save the Date: Cocktails for A Cause We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health Inc. on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA. Sponsored by Cellular Performance Institute, this special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, inspiring presentations from featured speakers (to be announced), and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences. Tickets are $85 per person, and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health Inc.’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions. We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families. BUY TICKETS HERE () Please Vote for the 2026 Author of the Year We are honored to share that Tracy Slepcevic, Co-Founder and President of Autism Health Inc., has been nominated for the 2026 Author of the Year award through the International Impact Book Awards. Tracy’s bestselling book, Warrior Mom: A Mother's Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism, has inspired and empowered families around the world through her heartfelt story of perseverance, faith, and determination as a mother navigating the autism journey. More than just a memoir, Warrior Mom has become a trusted guidebook for parents seeking hope, practical insight, and encouragement while advocating for their children. The book has received praise from many respected voices, including the endorsement from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who described Warrior Mom as: “An inspiring testimony to the miraculous power of maternal love.” We would deeply appreciate your support in helping recognize Tracy’s impact and dedication to the autism community. Voting closes on August 31, 2026, and every vote makes a difference. Learn more about Warrior Mom at: www.WarriorMom.com () VOTE HERE () About Autism Health Inc. Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders. | | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMay 13, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**WASHINGTON REPORTER: FLEMING’S WASHINGTON LOBBYING TIES BECOMING MAJOR LIABILITY IN SENATE RACE**
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow is calling on John Fleming to immediately resign from his position with a Washington, D.C. lobbying firm after a new [report](https://us.list-manage.com/LKV5hWCgei7?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a) revealed the Louisiana State Treasurer has been collecting a paycheck from a federal lobbying operation while serving in statewide office.
The explosive report from Washington Reporter comes after Fleming admitted during last week’s Senate debate that he is employed by the McKeon Group, a powerful Washington lobbying firm.
_“Louisianans are sick and tired of career politicians using public office to enrich themselves and climb the ladder in Washington,”_**said Congresswoman Letlow.**_“John Fleming is serving as Louisiana State Treasurer while simultaneously taking money from a D.C. lobbying firm, and the people of our state deserve answers immediately.”_
_“Who is paying him? What clients is he working for? Is he using his position as State Treasurer to benefit Washington interests? Louisiana taxpayers should not be left in the dark while their statewide elected official works for lobbyists in Washington.”_
The report details growing scrutiny surrounding Fleming’s dual role as Louisiana State Treasurer and paid employee of a lobbying firm with federal clients. Letlow is calling on Fleming to release records related to his employment and resign from the lobbying firm immediately.
The revelation has quickly become a major issue in the closing days of Louisiana’s Republican Senate primary as voters weigh the contrast between Letlow’s record of delivering for Louisiana in Congress and Fleming’s ties to the Washington lobbying world.
President Donald Trump endorsed Letlow in the race, praising her as a “strong conservative fighter” who will stand with him and advance the America First agenda in the Senate.
_“Louisiana deserves a Senator who will fight for our state, not someone tied to the same Washington lobbying culture voters are fed up with,”_**Rep. Letlow added.**

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: The Supreme Court cleared the way for more racist gerrymandering
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
In Louisiana v. Callais, the Court gutted one of the most important protections in the Voting Rights Act.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260513-6233-footer&t=1&akid=6233%2E420207%2Eitj48F)
Peter,
Watching the Supreme Court move in this direction is genuinely devastating.
The Supreme Court just cleared the way for Republicans to further gerrymander the congressional maps in states across the country. In _Louisiana v. Callais_ , the Court gutted one of the most important protections in the Voting Rights Act and made it dramatically harder for voters of color to challenge racist gerrymandering in court.
**And already Republicans have wasted no time in drawing new maps that silence voters and eliminate majority-Black districts.**
MAGA Republicans know that if everyone participates, they can’t win. So, instead of fighting for policies that serve the working people they’re supposed to serve, they stack the courts and suppress votes.
They’re trying to entrench minority rule by any means necessary, and unless we stand up, fight back, and vote in overwhelming numbers this November, this decision could shape Congress for years to come.
In Congress, I’m going to keep fighting for bolder federal protections for voting rights, an end to partisan gerrymandering, and structural reforms to a Supreme Court that has become dangerously disconnected from the people it serves.
But the far-right billionaires who are celebrating this decision are going to spend big to try and stop us, and I’m counting on the support of this grassroots movement to help me keep going.
I don’t take corporate PAC money, and I don’t have billionaires on speed dial to fund my campaign. I’m accountable to the working people I’m fighting for in Congress — which is why today, I’m asking you to [**pitch in $3 to help fuel our fight for voting rights, fair representation and a democracy that belongs to all of us, not just billionaires and extremist judges.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260513-1.Xb7e7k&refcode=em20260513-6233&amount=3&t=2&akid=6233%2E420207%2Eitj48F)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260513-1.Xb7e7k&amount=3&refcode=em20260513-6233&t=21&akid=6233%2E420207%2Eitj48F)**
This decision is undoubtedly a setback, but our movement has overcome the odds before. We’ve organized, marched, and won elections people said it would be impossible to win. And we’re not stopping now.
Thank you for standing with me.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260513-6233-footer&t=22&refcode2=6233_420207_itj48F&akid=6233%2E420207%2Eitj48F)**

I’m fighting for trust, transparency, and real results.

body:
From the Desk of State Representative Katrina Pierson
| | | |
---
| | | _From the Desk of State Representative Katrina Pierson_
_**A Message from Representative Pierson**_
It continues to be my distinct honor to serve House District 33 as your State Representative. Last year held the 89th Legislative Session and two special sessions, in which I fought for conservative policy that would not only hold benefit for the State of Texas, but would also protect the unique interests of HD 33 residents. This year, as we prepare for the 90th Legislative Session, I seek to carry forward that same fight and advance the conservative priorities that you and I care about.
I’ve also seen the outpouring of feedback, ideas, and thankfulness from my constituents. I appreciate communication from those who encounter daily the effects of policy, and can provide me with real-life insights into the issues they see every day. I thank you all for your support.
Best regards, Representative Katrina Pierson
---
| |
---
**_In Case You Missed It: Recent Recognitions_**

| |
---
| | The Republican National Platform Rankings designated Representative Pierson as one of 51 members nation-wide to receive the “Standard Bearer Award” for consistently voting in alignment with the Republican Party Platform.
---
| | Texas Values has named Representative Pierson a Texas Faith and Family Champion for the 2025 Legislative Session, for her support of pro-faith and pro-family legislation.
89th Legislative Christian Scores are calculated by “See It Name It Fight It”, an organization dedicated to fighting **against** Christian influence. Representative Pierson received a F rating and a recognition as Christian Nationalism Ambassador.
After Representative Pierson’s consistently strong support of pro-taxpayer policies during the 89th Legislative Session, Texans for Fiscal Responsibility awarded Representative Pierson a score of 94 and a grade of A, putting her among the top eleven House lawmakers to receive such a high score.
2025 Legislative Rankings, complied by Rice University, announced that Representative Katrina Pierson ranked #1 most conservative in Collin County Delegation and top 8% in most conservative legislators in Texas.
**_Texas Education Freedom Accounts Program Launch_**

---
For too long, the zip code where a child lives has determined the quality of the education they receive. But, as of February of 2026, those days are over. I am proud to announce that the Texas Education Freedom Accounts (TEFA) have officially launched, marking the dawn of a new era for Texas families.
When I ran for office, I promised to fight for the fundamental right of parents to direct the upbringing and education of their children. The voters of HD33 had overwhelming spoken in favor of school choice through the proposition elections of 2024, and I was excited to deliver on the change Texans knew was needed. The passage of Senate Bill 2 wasn't just a legislative win; it was a strike for liberty. We have finally unbundled the classroom, ensuring that our tax dollars follow the student, not a government building.
The response has been nothing short of historic. In the first seven days, over 60,000 Texas families applied for an account, and over 274,000 students have submitted applications in total. This overwhelming demand proves what we’ve known all along: parents are hungry for options that align with their values and their children's unique needs. Education freedom has dawned in Texas.
**_1836 Project Advisory Committee_**
Representative Pierson was appointed to the 1836 Project Advisory Committee by Speaker Dustin Burrows, an initiative focused on strengthening understanding of our state’s history and values. Rep. Pierson attended her first 1836 Project Advisory Committee meeting, and looks forward to strengthening Texas by ensuring that its incredible history, unique heritage, and treasured principles continue to inspire future generations.
The next meeting of the 1836 Project will happen right here in HD 33 on May 7th, 2026.
**_EPIC City Updates and New Legal Action_**
[](https://link.mail.katrinafortexas.)
Texas Attorney General **Ken Paxton** has intensified state action against the East Plano Islamic Center’s large-scale development known as **The Meadow** (formerly EPIC City). In December 2025, Paxton launched an investigation alleging the developers engaged in deceptive practices and potential securities violations tied to the project. At the federal level, the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) opened a Fair Housing Act investigation in February 2026 following a complaint from the Texas Workforce Commission, which alleged the development was marketed as an exclusively Muslim community with discriminatory financial terms and a two-tiered lot lottery system.
A second major development came when Paxton filed [_a new lawsuit_](https://link.mail.katrinafortexas.) in February 2026 against Double R Municipal Utility District No. 2A, accusing its board of executing a highly unusual September 2025 meeting where members resigned en masse, were immediately replaced, and then voted to annex more than 400 acres to support the EPIC project. According to the lawsuit, the maneuver aimed to bypass required state oversight, and documentation later showed the newly installed directors were not legally qualified to serve. Paxton is seeking to remove the board members and invalidate the annexation.
A series of legal victories has followed, in which Attorney General Paxton has secured a Temporary Restraining Order and Temporary Injunction against the Double R Municipal Utility District 2A, preventing any further action until a lawful board of directors is appointed.
This current legal action comes at the heels of HB 4211’s passage by the Legislature and signing by Governor Abbott. HB 4211 was coauthored by Representative Pierson, and prohibits residential property developments like EPIC City from creating Sharia Compounds in Texas. The topic expects further discussion and action in the next Legislative Session, as Representative Pierson and 37 other Texas House Members form the Sharia-Free Texas Caucus.
_**Community Updates and District Highlights**_
**_Safe Haven Baby Box_**
Representative Pierson was honored to speak at the dedication ceremony for the McLendon Chisholm Safe Haven Baby Box, a life saving device that provides a safe and compassionate option for parents in crisis, and allows the community of HD33 to care for our most vulnerable lives.
**_Texas Women’s Leadership Conference_**
The Texas Women’s Leadership Conference brings together female leaders from across Texas who are committed to service, excellence, and strengthening our communities. Representative Pierson had the pleasure of attending the inaugural Texas Women’s Conference as a guest of the Texas First Lady, Cecilia Abbott.
_**Constituent Services Highlight**_
**Did You Know?** If you’re having trouble getting in contact with a state agency, constituents can reach out to the Office of Representative Pierson for assistance in facilitating good communication between you and the agency and timely processing of your request!
**Thank You for Your Support** I am grateful for your continued engagement—whether by phone, email, or personal visits to the Capitol. Please know that I will keep listening and working diligently on your behalf to secure a thriving future for Rockwall and Collin County.
**Contact Information**
* **Phone** : (512) 463-0484
* **Email** : District33.Pierson@house.texas.gov

If you have questions, concerns, or suggestions, do not hesitate to reach out. My team and I are here to serve you.
**Sincerely,**
**Katrina Pierson**
_State Representative_

Let's be clear about what's at stake on Tuesday:
PA-03 is the bluest congressional district in the entire country — D+40, with Kamala Harris winning 88% of the vote in 2024. And with the seat now open, whoever wins this Democratic primary on May 19 is going to Congress. Full stop.
**But we don’t need another establishment Democrat content to keep the seat warm while our planet burns and working people and families get crushed. We need someone with the courage and clarity to take on Trump across every single front where he’s attacking us.**
This administration isn’t only coming for our climate. They’re coming for our democracy, our health care, our immigrant neighbors, and the basic freedoms of working people everywhere. So the Democrats we send to Washington can’t afford to be one-dimensional.
**Chris Rabb is the leader this moment demands:**
💪 A bold progressive who supports **Medicare for All** so every American has guaranteed healthcare
🛑 A fearless advocate for **abolishing ICE** and protecting immigrant families from Trump's cruelty
✊ A **fighter for working families** in Nicetown, Southwest Philly, and every neighborhood that's been written off for too long
🌎 A **founding member of Pennsylvania's Climate Caucus** who introduced legislation to get PA to 100% renewable energy by 2050
🚫 A candidate who **refuses every dollar of corporate PAC money**

SCOTUS has been hijacked by MAGA extremists hellbent on rolling back decades of progress on Civil Rights, Women's Rights, voting rights, and environmental protections.
The takeover was orchestrated by right-wing extremist Leonard Leo -- leader of the Federalist Society, architect of a $1.6 billion dark money network, and the man who placed Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Barrett on the bench justice by justice over the course of thirty years. The same man whose network is now seizing voter records in eight states and preparing to challenge hundreds of thousands of Democratic votes in the midterms.
The same dark money machine we defeated in Pennsylvania. In Wisconsin. The same one we need to crush Tuesday in Georgia.
If Trump replaces two or three more justices on the court, and he has already said he will, Leonard Leo's stranglehold on American democracy could last a generation.
We are not going to let that happen. The Constitution does not set the number of justices. Expanding the court does not require a constitutional amendment. It requires Democrats to control the White House, Senate, and House. And perhaps more importantly--the will to act from elected Democrats.
We are building the political momentum for SCOTUS reform starting right now. So when Democrats retake power, reform won't just be a debate. It will be a mandate.
You helped us win Pennsylvania. Wisconsin. But the state court firewall is not enough. Tonight, Defend Our Courts is launching the Unpack Our Courts movement -- the fight that defines the next generation of American democracy.

Ted Cruz’s disdain for people with working-class jobs is no secret.
#
Ted Cruz recently went on Fox News to call me a 'parasite' and disparaged my work as a bartender:
**Ted Cruz’s disdain for people with working-class jobs is no secret.**
It’s not a secret what he thinks of waitresses, line cooks — he thinks we’re less than him.
Ted Cruz thinks that because he has a Harvard degree and has never scrubbed a table, that makes him better than someone who’s actually had to work for a living.
It’s funny that he’s been taking a government paycheck for 23 years, but has the audacity to criticize someone who had to work their way up and earn their place in Congress.
I’m running for election in fierce advocacy of working class Americans because we can make a new world, a better country, where we fight for the dignity of all people.

Hi Peter, it's Sherrod Brown reaching out urgently. My opponent just started airing his first attack ad against me. His super PAC is spending _over a million dollars_ to plaster the airwaves here in Ohio and mislead swing voters. **We need to respond right away.** [_**So my team is launching an emergency rapid-response goal to raise $200,000 so we can get our own ads on the air ASAP and fight back. Please split a donation between Tammy Baldwin and me:**_](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/5545?t=4&akid=5422%2E35263%2EyyWA2r) | [DONATE](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/5545?t=5&akid=5422%2E35263%2EyyWA2r)
---
**The GOP has made it clear that defeating our campaign is their top priority.**
Poll after poll proves we have a serious shot at winning in Ohio and _The Cook Political Report_ has moved this race in my favor _twice._ On top of that, Senate Republicans' biggest super PAC announced their largest cash infusion of the year will be in Ohio. Now, my opponent is launching ads of his own – _much earlier than we expected._
The harsh reality is if we don’t respond today, persuadable voters will _only_ be seeing these misleading ads against us. **That will put our chances of flipping this seat in serious jeopardy.**
We can’t let this become a one-sided fight. The only way we can stay competitive in this race is by getting on even financial footing. So I need you to chip in – even $10.
Look, Peter — $10 might not sound like the kind of money that can fend off $80 million in GOP spending. But together, it all adds up. And by the time you’re reading this, someone else has already chipped in.
[**Will you step up by splitting $10 (or whatever you can give right now) to help us reach our $200K emergency goal?**_](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/5546?t=6&akid=5422%2E35263%2EyyWA2r)

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.
