Over the last four months, President Donald Trump has launched a series of bold foreign policy moves that are changing global energy flows, strengthening the U.S. economy, and pressuring China, even as his critics call the approach risky and escalatory. This leverage matters as President Trump meets with Xi Jinping.
From the U.S. operation that captured Venezuelan dictator Nicolas Maduro in January to military strikes against Iranian targets that began in late February, Trump's actions have put America back in a position of clear strength on the world stage.
LOOMER UNLEASHED is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pgm1qS3IlXQyGL_Wbx4uwrL2m4IdeGtuHvGaR-nuSuk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=197526023)
President Trump's critics in the media, on social media, and in government have argued that his foreign policy is reckless and could lead to wider instability. But early economic signs tell a different story: foreign investment in the U.S. is rising, the dollar is gaining ground, and American manufacturing is showing new life.
Many experts predicted market trouble because of conflicts in the Middle East and swings in oil prices. So far, that hasn't happened.
U.S. financial markets have held up well. Foreign investors continue to buy American stocks, bonds, and other assets at a faster pace than in recent years, and demand for U.S. Treasuries remains solid.
The U.S. dollar now accounts for a [record ](https://substack.com/redirect/7789c700-ad47-4ec4-bd57-c0973fbdd0f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)51.1% of global transactions as of March 2026, according to SWIFT data, up from 49.2% the month before. Even during periods of conflict, the dollar is still seen as the world's safest currency. Efforts by BRICS nations to reduce reliance on the dollar have had limited success, and about 80% of international oil sales are still priced in dollars.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/852a9e45-7bd6-48d4-843e-741329f4677c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## **How Trump Stopped The Flow Of Cheap Oil To China**
A major result of Trump's actions has been a shift in the global oil market. For years, Iran and Venezuela supplied China with [discounted](https://substack.com/redirect/5423df2f-0b23-4481-b1d3-01bc9a563c4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) crude oil, often through shadow fleets that avoided and violated U.S. sanctions. After Maduro's removal and tighter enforcement on Iranian exports, tanker routes have changed, and more oil is now heading toward U.S. ports.
China, which once bought 80-90% of Iran's exported oil, must now purchase oil at full market prices and pay in dollars. The country has large stockpiles of about 1.4 billion barrels that can last several months, but the higher costs are adding pressure to China's economy at a time when its exports are already slowing. Meanwhile, U.S. oil and natural gas production and exports continue to grow.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6c9c242-1e3a-4564-b9ee-48fe26fdbb75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pgm1qS3IlXQyGL_Wbx4uwrL2m4IdeGtuHvGaR-nuSuk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=197526023)
## **Companies Bet Big on American Manufacturing**
Central to President Trump's [agenda](https://substack.com/redirect/c2273845-c1b6-4fa6-9b00-1a1e98f4f9fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is bringing factories and jobs back to the United States. Despite criticism that his policies are too protectionist, major companies are making large [commitments](https://substack.com/redirect/c6ea293b-4c98-4207-aabf-86df85ba91ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including:
* Skydio[ pledged](https://substack.com/redirect/e6ff0e2e-a3ba-4a8d-b8f0-dd77216dbcae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $3.5 billion to expand drone manufacturing in the U.S.
* GlobalFoundries [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/c8663589-d864-4461-8be3-fe23bf9e03df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a $16 billion investment in American semiconductor and AI production.
* Apple [increased](https://substack.com/redirect/b7d041d9-32fb-456b-ae4e-de8b8e28c6fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its U.S. commitment to $600 billion.
* Johnson & Johnson [plans](https://substack.com/redirect/fc9f1f20-4a51-42bf-8ed8-9f4c2dfaf9da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to invest more than $55 billion over four years.
* NVIDIA is [preparing](https://substack.com/redirect/b434e492-a050-49df-9f5e-47157e235cb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $500 billion in U.S. manufacturing.
* Ford now [builds](https://substack.com/redirect/59acfe7d-1569-4cae-9176-9b8f3465ec74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 83% of its vehicles domestically, part of a broader comeback in American auto production.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d2778391-7b71-4f24-bcc6-c01a10cccc6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Other firms are also expanding their manufacturing in America as manufacturing activity has reached multi-year highs, and foreign companies continue to invest in the United States.
Many analysts describe the current U.S.-China relationship as a new Cold War. Iran and Venezuela had served as China's key suppliers, helping fuel China's economic and geopolitical plans with oil. Trump's moves have disrupted those low-cost energy channels that benefited China, especially in the Western Hemisphere.
Chinese communist state media continues to downplay U.S. strength, but investment data and the dollar's performance suggest the world still has confidence in American stability and President Trump's leadership.
So what do all of these wins mean for the United States and President Trump?
As Trump's second term continues, the key question is whether these high-stakes decisions will secure long-term U.S. leadership in a post-Trump America.
For decades, America watched as adversaries exploited weak leadership, cheap energy loopholes, and offshored factories to erode U.S. dominance and America First manufacturing. President Trump has decisively reversed that trend. His willingness to wield American power, without apology, has redirected energy flows, fortified the dollar's dominance, and triggered a historic wave of domestic investment. He has incentivized bringing manufacturing back to America.
Trump's critics will continue to clutch their pearls over claims of "escalation" and "recklessness." However, the data tells the real story: rising foreign capital inflows, record dollar usage, booming manufacturing commitments from major companies, and a tightening noose around China's subsidized energy lifeline. These are not abstract theories, but they are measurable gains proving that President Trump is delivering jobs, energy and security to the American people.
As Trump's second term unfolds, the verdict is already forming. By confronting threats directly, enforcing sanctions ruthlessly, and prioritizing American industry, this administration is not merely managing decline, it is engineering a durable resurgence. The early returns are clear: U.S. strategic advantages are expanding, rivals are on the defensive, and the world is once again seeing what decisive American leadership looks like.
The high-stakes choices made by President Trump during the first four months of 2026 are laying the foundation for long-term dominance that outlasts any single administration. | | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---

_But now, Peter, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

**P.S.** There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out...

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Peter, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

clean_body: Before you give up on America — read this | | | | | Peter, If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left... If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good... If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, " Is it already too late?" You're not alone. A lot of good people have been asking the same question. But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That was no small feat. Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked. So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle. Then Charlie called me... He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster." I told him, "We are." Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said, "How many are there?" "About 27,000." Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!" I'll be honest -- I froze. We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet. But he wasn't fazed. He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together." That was Charlie. He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday." He believed in going now. And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself. He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality. That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place. That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: We're in 3,300. That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America. Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Peter, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Peter, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | If you’re near or over 73, this matters. subject: This is the moment we’ve been building towards

body:
This is the moment, and I need you in it with us. Here’s our plan:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260513-1&t=1&akid=3474%2E587540%2ETmk_By)
Peter,
I’m going to be straight with you.
The moment we’re in right now is unlike anything Leaders We Deserve has faced since we started our mission.
The Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Trump is waging an illegal war in Iran. Healthcare is out of reach for millions of people. Corporate landlords are gobbling up homes and pricing working families out of their neighborhoods. And many leaders in the Democratic Party are still figuring out if they’re willing to fight back with more than just a strongly worded letter.
Honestly, we don't have the luxury to wait around for the rest of the Party to wake up. We have to start moving on the issues that matter to us most and electing the leaders who will get us there right now.
That’s why this is our biggest year yet. We’ll be backing the largest slate of candidates we've ever had. There are more races to fight ahead, and more opportunities to prove that bold, people-powered politics can win anywhere in this country.
The House majority is within reach. State legislatures are flippable. And what we do between now and November will determine whether we rise to meet this moment or let it slip through our fingers.
So here’s our plan for this cycle:
* **Back the boldest, most fearless progressive candidates running for state legislatures and Congress across the country.** People who come from the communities they’re fighting for, refuse corporate PAC money, and have the courage to do what’s right instead of what’s safe.
* **Challenge asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats in safe blue seats who are failing to meet this moment in order to strengthen our Party.** Voters deserve a Party that actually holds its leaders accountable and is willing to respond to the urgency of this moment with the moral clarity and vision for the future that it demands.

This plan works. We’ve already proven that, and taken home meaningful wins this cycle. But none of this work happens without resources. We don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or special interests. We don’t have the establishment funding machine behind us, or self interested mega donors writing us checks. We have you, and tens of thousands of people like you who truly believe in what we’re building.
So here’s what I’m asking, Peter:
**[If you’re in a position to give big — $500, $1,000, or more — now is the moment.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260513_1_tiers.2s-j-c&refcode=em20260513-3474&amount=500&t=2&akid=3474%2E587540%2ETmk_By)** Your support doesn’t just fund one candidate, it funds the infrastructure that finds them, supports their campaigns on a daily basis, and gets them across the finish line.
**[If you can give a little every month — $5, $25, $50 — we need you standing with us.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2774?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260513_1_tiers.JlVNpV&refcode=em20260513-3474&amount=5&t=3&akid=3474%2E587540%2ETmk_By)** Recurring donors are at the backbone of what we do. They’re the reason we can plan ahead, invest early, and show up for candidates when it counts the most.
**[If you can only give once — whatever you can afford — we appreciate that deeply.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260513_1_tiers.2s-j-c&refcode=em20260513-3474&amount=5&t=4&akid=3474%2E587540%2ETmk_By)** Every dollar is proof that this isn’t a movement bought and paid for by corporate PACs or special interests. It’s a people-powered movement, ready to win.
**And if you can’t give anything right now** — _that’s okay._ Not everyone is in a position to contribute money, and I completely understand that. What I’m asking for instead: Forward this email. Share what we’re doing on your social media. Talk to a friend or family member about Justin J. Pearson, Ruwa Romman, Christian Menefee, or any of the incredible candidates we’re backing this cycle. Bring someone else along with you in this fight.
This is the moment. And we need you in it. Whatever you’re able to contribute today, please know that it truly makes a difference. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for showing up for this movement. I’m grateful to be doing this work alongside you.
With gratitude,
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

**[DataRepublican never spoke in a meeting. A million people are listening now.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Jennica Pounds—known online as DataRepublican, small r—is deaf and nonspeaking. She spent more than fifteen years inside some of the biggest technology companies in the world: Amazon, eBay, Snap, Upstart, where she was a senior distinguished machine learning engineer.
Today, her X account has more than a million followers. Elon Musk has amplified her work at least two dozen times. Sen. Mike Lee of Utah has called her “a gift to America.” Her tools at datarepublican.com track 913,000 nonprofits and 1.3 million grants, and they’re built around a single conviction: data does not equal transparency.
She’s bringing that work to Colorado. DataRepublican is a featured speaker at RMV’s Freedom Festival on Saturday, June 27, at the Douglas County Fairgrounds in Castle Rock.

**[Colorado’s Fair Map Fight: What’s Happening and Why It Matters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY ROBYN CARNES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Colorado’s independent redistricting system faces a new challenge:** Competing ballot initiatives for 2026 would either preserve the state’s voter-approved independent commission or replace it with maps projected to give Democrats a 7-1 congressional advantage.
* **Critics warn partisan map proposals could weaken voter influence:** Supporters of the current commission argue competitive districts protect independent voters and keep elections accountable, while opponents of the existing system say changes are needed in response to redistricting battles in other states.
* **Fight could become a major statewide ballot battle:** Initiative #327 remains before the Colorado Supreme Court, setting up a possible November showdown between proposals framed as protecting fair representation versus reshaping congressional power in Colorado.

* **Judge quickly denies Tina Peters’ renewed disqualification motion:** Mesa County Judge Matthew Barrett rejected Peters’ latest effort to remove him from the case just 96 minutes after the motion was filed, despite defense attorneys citing Colorado and U.S. Supreme Court precedent supporting judicial recusal standards.
* **Defense argues court ignored sworn affidavits and due process concerns:** Peters’ attorneys said Barrett improperly dismissed affidavits questioning his impartiality, including testimony from Colorado State Patrol Chaplain Rev. Robert Babcox, who stated he believed Peters was guilty but still questioned whether she received a fair sentencing process.
* **Case continues amid ongoing scrutiny of judicial conduct:** The defense argues Barrett failed to address key legal standards requiring affidavits supporting disqualification motions to be presumed true, while Peters remains in custody more than 580 days after sentencing with no resentencing date set.

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MAY 11** _Colorado’s magazine ban has been challenged before. The surprise this time is not the Second Amendment argument. It is the DOJ’s decision to use a federal civil-rights law traditionally aimed at police misconduct investigations to make it. On May 5, federal attorneys filed against Denver over its assault-weapons ban. The next morning, they were back in court with another complaint—this one against the state, over the 15-round magazine limit._
__
**[When the people vote, the majority should not pre-load a workaround](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY C. J. GARBO | COMMENTARY | MAY 11** _Colorado is supposed to be a representative government, not a manager class that “handles” voters the way an accountant handles a problem line item. Yet that is exactly what HB26-1430 represents: a legislature preparing a conditional “counterpunch” that activates only if voters approve Initiative 175 this November._ __

**[Manny Rutinel wants to represent Colorado’s oil country. His law is bearing down on its only refinery.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MAY 8** _State Rep. Manny Rutinel is asking voters in the heart of Colorado’s oil country to send him to Congress. Seven weeks from now, a law Rutinel helped write could reshape how Colorado’s only petroleum refinery operates._

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: I’m introducing a bill for Universal School Meals
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
This is a common-sense idea
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2211%2E791427%2EZ0wzPU)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-may26/?source=em260513-1-180&refcode2=2211.791427.Z0wzPU&akid=2211%2E791427%2EZ0wzPU)
Friend,
Today me and my friend Bernie Sanders are introducing a bill in Congress called the Universal School Meals Program Act.
The idea is simple. When we send our kids to school, they should be focused on their education, not worrying about when they will get their next meal. It’s time to remove the stigma that kids from low-income families face and provide food for all of our children in America’s public schools.
[**Please, add your name as a citizen Co-sponsor to my bill and help me show grassroots support for this common-sense idea >>**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-may26/?source=em260513-1-180&refcode2=2211.791427.Z0wzPU&akid=2211%2E791427%2EZ0wzPU)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-may26/?source=em260513-1-180&refcode2=2211.791427.Z0wzPU&akid=2211%2E791427%2EZ0wzPU)**
Friend, when Minnesota passed legislation to provide free school meals in 2023, there were, of course, naysayers and opposition, especially from Republicans.
But three years later, this initiative has turned out to be a popular program and a smashing success. Hundreds of millions of meals have been served and countless families have felt the relief of knowing their child will get the food they need regardless of their family’s financial situation.
And years of research consistently back up the idea that access to free school meals significantly improves educational outcomes by improving attendance, concentration, and performance while reducing behavioral issues.
Now it’s time to take this idea nationwide and ensure that every child, no matter their income, gets the nutrition they need to stay focused on their studies and thrive in any educational environment.
[**While this may be a no-brainer for most Americans, powerful corporate interests and the far-right have worked together to block my bill from being passed. Please, help us rally support for universal school meals by signing on as a citizen Co-sponsor of my bill with Bernie Sanders today:**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-may26/?source=em260513-1-180&refcode2=2211.791427.Z0wzPU&akid=2211%2E791427%2EZ0wzPU)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-may26/?source=em260513-1-180&refcode2=2211.791427.Z0wzPU&akid=2211%2E791427%2EZ0wzPU)**
Leading a successful life starts with getting a quality education, and that simply can’t happen on an empty stomach. I hope you can sign on today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

## Sen. Steven Roberts Advances Major Economic Development Package to Revitalize Missouri Communities

Together, the measures represent years of work to modernize the state's approach to redevelopment and economic development while delivering new opportunities for both urban and rural communities.

* [**Senate Bill 869**](http://url5914.robertsforstl.com/ls/click?upn=u001.fzG53TkBvmRvO32ahM-2BnoTAzfPYg4QsBmRSXo3mMrIvOZcIJSQXsQ9ut-2BxOjt4e07QndstQtY4yzlyyVJQNQF6TM0Mgy95GikrgiEj9sCnnNpWuqL2Nu2oactVQWlT94BggL_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVCKy-2B-2B58EQo9OBZ1DFkEmwuM7vQygzizVvxKmA-2F9J-2FE19DrCJBiChnWEt1YTcce0486aCCtakNmtIV2Bwhjynf9Hi6ChikaWGsW2E-2FoTBQUw0amKKfsgRsomawACCZvEmxXlYmLBHaAoHThP8skBeCwFDEg2-2Bi7kWJSLIhL9rXgguatropZVlaSzMcc8LQWoJS29xa-2B3MHe6F3XZA-2F3XwYfGax5sh5iXvsyZGc-2F2Y0myEx16unaMoHSbKcgDy3XQEGmCJMFnMcXGx8AdYCmeByDDjoWhcHHSgsnCjtqQ6oJBXYuzEOejrDDVCCkAS4omyOftdhqENslxlwPnZHz9XLVfVmnPbx-2B4NwgdvS9wNK4SwTDvGhXY4rfeIRXtaqrqvXVazyaJdhS2WBBOHbLePwQ4B6SneWociXlf9wAUOo1Uhn8p-2B3yj7flLgHO0JjGWQ5seRIG5lRqfenSmDQ2kIWlpm-2BDkJw-2FcecX7cHeJqjhHPS5gGKBdULyRDg9fg4-2Fw3tIPaywpVWDZPKa57b1AFTIIHEMk8fiEPna2WJSDvbKsoP9p06R33jmf79pNRmhjtO-2FEkvVhADUvP7ZTTWyqOosPFEJIyCOfXiHlWek-2BihEi6Nh3VaSxmON8WxG75MZW62MTz4Ztk1utFvwAXf4w2taeh9ubOWBUn-2BUyG-2Bm-2Ba5pCzW38qgKyZAtnuvR-2FQUJHweTUGgynDSGh37jTCHv66bVHj80NN70ozpvq-2FZoJiflvnh1JS1j-2FpncGzKo-2BX2SQPYwy-2F8ANDZqnVQDXzdZUJhE1sKtV9WiTsgvXs1FseB8OghGn9emVVMaTXlJh-2FcCThBNLiDeG94HJwjiMIJtrPXAziZrG6KIyQ-2BvKADOWPVEDse8avZC9FiMDqZqqANujHo-3D)**-** Creating office-to-residential and Main Street conversion tax credits

"We have worked with legislators in both chambers, local leaders, residents, business owners, and stakeholders across Missouri to build a comprehensive strategy for economic growth that would be a catalyst for Downtown St. Louis and the downtowns and main streets across Missouri. This result is a bill that is not just about renovating the ATT Tower or the Railway Exchange; this bill is about realizing the dream of a Downtown community.”
**Revitalizing Missouri Downtowns and Main Streets Act (SB 869)**
Senate Bill 869 establishes the **“Revitalizing Missouri Downtowns and Main Streets Act,”** legislation focused on transforming vacant and underutilized commercial properties into housing, mixed-use developments, and vibrant community spaces. House Bill 3231 expands upon that framework to include all of Missouri’s cities and towns.
**What SB 869 Does**
* Encourages redevelopment of vacant commercial buildings
* Supports housing and mixed-use development projects
* Expands redevelopment tools to communities statewide
* Helps cities revitalize downtowns and main streets

“This legislation is the culmination of more than three
years of work. Where earlier efforts were focused on rehabilitating specific
buildings, this bill is about building entire communities. It gives cities like
St. Louis the tools to turn long-vacant properties into housing and economic
opportunity while helping communities across Missouri revitalize their
downtowns and main streets.” **Missouri Angel Investment Act (SB 1563)**
Senate Bill 1563 establishes the **Missouri Angel Investment Act** , designed to encourage private investment in emerging businesses and startups throughout the state.
**What SB 1563 Does**
* Encourages investment in Missouri startups
* Expands access to early-stage capital
* Helps entrepreneurs grow businesses in Missouri
* Strengthens innovation and job creation statewide

“St. Louis has incredible entrepreneurs and innovators, but too often, promising businesses struggle to access early-stage capital. The Missouri Angel Investment Act ensures local startups stay local and grow here instead of being lured to the coasts.” **MODESA 2.0 (SB 1694)**
Senate Bill 1694 modernizes and expands MODESA to attract investment and support economic growth around St. Louis’s world-class assets. MODESA will support the completion of Ballpark Village, the redevelopment of the Millennium Hotel site, and expand eligibility to areas surrounding Energizer Park.
**What SB 1694 Does**
* Modernizes the MODESA program
* Supports new residential development downtown
* Expands redevelopment eligibility areas
* Leverages major entertainment and tourism anchors for growth

“MODESA has already proven to be an effective economic development tool, and this legislation builds on that success. MODESA 2.0 expands a proven framework to include incentives for new residential units in the heart of Downtown and Downtown West around world-class stadiums that attract millions of visitors a year. Leveraging those anchors is how we transform Downtown from a place people visit to a place people live.”
---

| | |
---
**About Steve Roberts**
Senator Steven Roberts, a fourth-generation St. Louis native, was sworn into office on January 6, 2021, to represent Missouri’s 5th Senatorial District and was selected as the Democratic Whip for the Minority Caucus. Previously, he served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020 and chaired the Missouri Legislative Black Caucus. A graduate of the University of Miami and Pepperdine Law, he has worked in Congress, as a prosecutor in St. Louis, and as a Captain in the Missouri Air National Guard’s JAG Corps. He also manages Roberts Law, LLC, and remains active in Missouri’s legal and civic communities.

# Oregon DOJ is fighting for Oregonians – and winning.
We’re working every day to keep communities safe, protect seniors, children, and working families, and uphold Oregon’s laws & values. We’re taking action to protect vote-by-mail, prevent mergers & monopolies that would raise prices, prosecute Medicaid fraud, and much more. And we want to hear from you. Read on for:
* Ongoing work to prevent corporate mergers, including Live Nation/Ticketmaster win
* Upcoming town halls in Pendleton & Coos Bay
* A cold case, solved
* ...and more!

Thank you, Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General
---
Section 3
| |
* * *
---
Section 4
|
# Fighting corporate mergers to keep prices low
We recently had a huge win for working families: [a jury sided with our multistate coalition challenging Live Nation/Ticketmaster](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-and-coalition-win-trial-against-live-nation-ticketmaster%2F/1/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/vJmYswuJfhjAKJvUexysxsd17aO20AqhDHvpH_4LwqY=452) for raising prices for artists, venues, and concert goers. As the federal government steps back from preventing big corporate mergers, Oregon is stepping up. We also recently [announced our new plan to keep costs from going up across the state](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-calls-for-state-resources-to-address-growing-mergers-monopolies%2F/1/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/KWiXxHe8d7heFuDQrBCj8D8im8htBEQZVUy7nWvm-gU=452) by expanding this antitrust enforcement work.

# Protecting mail-in voting
Oregonians have voted by mail for 30 years, under both Republican and Democratic administrations. That's why we're taking action to protect access to voting by mail for all Oregon voters. [Watch our recent conversation on KGW's Straight Talk.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.kgw.com%2Farticle%2Fentertainment%2Ftelevision%2Fprograms%2Fstraight-talk%2Foregon-ag-dan-rayfield-warning-trump-mail-in-voting-postal-service%2F283-a1ac0143-be00-4d99-8de3-a13ecf8b5dba/2/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/W7tTFwyHlSc3MeeqO7NATHd-YxfnBPDmOY_f2la06Sc=452) The Oregon primary election is May 19, so remember to turn in your ballot!

# Fighting Medicaid fraud
Medicaid exists to make sure people can get the help they need for their health, their housing, and their children’s mental wellbeing – and when people choose to exploit the system for personal gain, we will hold them accountable. Oregon DOJ has recovered over $85 million in Medicaid fraud in the past 10 years, including three recent charges and convictions. [Learn more.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-announces-medicaid-fraud-charges-and-convictions-in-three-separate-multnomah-county-cases%2F/1/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/htKnD53QpWenCsVDFF2FeBi_NTWq-E3uk7UoYqicayo=452)

# Court win in 2nd tariffs case
The Supreme Court sided with Oregon and overturned the president’s first round of illegal tariffs in February – and instead of focusing on refunds, he tried imposing a second round of illegal tariffs, so we sued again. [A federal court sided with our coalition in this second lawsuit last week.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-wins-second-tariff-lawsuit%2F/1/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/EumE8usXbxvZO5LPe0pGBiTFcgWzGGjvJf1CVsmauLs=452) We’ll continue to fight for Oregon’s working families and small businesses and make sure no one is above the law.

# Public safety pilot program: 6 months in
We’re working every day to keep communities safe. It’s been 6 months since we launched SPIRE, a public safety pilot program in Washington County where we partner with local law enforcement to tackle complex organized crime, and we’ve already had some significant wins. [Learn more.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2Fy8mpsnrdET0/2/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/l59dF8f4WF00mGOCli9-7O40ouEhYzAHH3gUhQ-S8dw=452)

# A cold case, solved
We recently [secured a 20-year sentence in a 1983 cold case homicide](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fpeople.com%2Fman-20-years-prison-murder-girlfriend-40-years-11955560/1/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/hmVm9-nwk4mMrVODgQ92gaQhGGMDO3zHdprJua0Qq1s=452) in Josephine County – a joint effort with multiple law enforcement offices in Josephine County and beyond. We also [secured a life sentence](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fpeople.com%2Fwoman-who-murdered-navy-vet-ex-husband-fled-country-with-their-daughter-sentenced-11965829/1/0101019e23115195-e6afce65-35ff-477d-9926-09a45344adfd-000000/Rv0KJi5px9Xf5p6R8ezcjBKnSHF1t_7DqdZ0jeiW_V8=452) for a Coos County woman who murdered her ex-husband. We’ll continue working every day to keep communities safe across our state.

clean_body: | | Section 1 | | Section 2 | Oregon DOJ is fighting for Oregonians – and winning. We’re working every day to keep communities safe, protect seniors, children, and working families, and uphold Oregon’s laws & values. We’re taking action to protect vote-by-mail, prevent mergers & monopolies that would raise prices, prosecute Medicaid fraud, and much more. And we want to hear from you. Read on for: Ongoing work to prevent corporate mergers, including Live Nation/Ticketmaster win Upcoming town halls in Pendleton & Coos Bay A cold case, solved ...and more! Thank you, Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General Section 3 | | Section 4 | Fighting corporate mergers to keep prices low We recently had a huge win for working families: for raising prices for artists, venues, and concert goers. As the federal government steps back from preventing big corporate mergers, Oregon is stepping up. We also recently by expanding this antitrust enforcement work. Section 5 | | Section 6 | Protecting mail-in voting Oregonians have voted by mail for 30 years, under both Republican and Democratic administrations. That's why we're taking action to protect access to voting by mail for all Oregon voters. The Oregon primary election is May 19, so remember to turn in your ballot! The _Cook Political Report_ rates our race a total toss-up. That means we have a real chance to elect Aaron and flip Nevada blue, but we can’t take anything for granted.

**" You're not in trouble."**

**" And you don't go back."**She took a step.

She walked out **FREE.**

Another message. Another hotel room and another piece of herself she would have to leave behind.She had no reason to think anything would change. But this time, someone was coming.She received the message.A time. A place. Nothing unusual. That's how traffickers keep control. Everything feels routine. Predictable. But behind that message, a rescue plan was already in motion. Our partners made contact through the ad. They spoke like buyers and kept everything normal. Because that's what it takes to reach victims like her and get close enough for the opportunity to pull them out. Her trafficker dropped her off like property, pretending to be something he wasn't. But law enforcement was ready. Watching. Waiting. And when he drove away, they moved in. The man that was controlling her life was arrested. She walked into the hotel, up to the room and knocked quietly. When the door opened, she didn't look up right away. Because this was survival. This was routine.But then everything changed." No one here is going to hurt you." " You're not in trouble." " We know who you are and we can get you out."They called her by her real name, then something shifted.She didn't run or speak. She froze. Because freedom doesn't feel real at first. It feels like another trap. So they waited. Calm. Patient." You don't have to go back."More silence until, she spoke out, " ...what happens to me?"" We walk out together." " And you don't go back."She took a step. Then another and just like that, everything changed. She walked out FREE. Peter, most of us here at VoteVets are Veterans of the last round of America’s military misadventures. The past few months have been tough.

Hey folks,
This one went everywhere -- **Don Lemon** and I dove into Trump's obsession with Obama, the panic setting in around the GOP, whether Texas is actually in play, and what Democrats still don't seem to understand about where the energy in this country really is. We got personal, we got philosophical, and we laughed a lot too.
There's something revealing about the way Trump talks about Obama. You can feel the resentment. The insecurity. And once we got into that conversation, it opened up a much bigger one about fear, identity, power, and what the next phase of American politics could actually look like.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] We break down why Obama still completely dominates Trump psychologically -- and why Trump's public meltdowns keep getting darker and more erratic.
* [**00:03:51**] Barack Obama quietly shows up in Texas, and suddenly the conversation shifts: Is Texas actually competitive now? We dig into the Senate map and what Democrats are seeing behind the scenes.
* [**00:09:57**] Ohio, Iowa, Alaska, Texas -- where can Democrats really win? We debate the strategy, the polling, and whether the political map is about to shift again.
* [**00:14:06**] A real conversation about the future of the Democratic Party: AOC, Pritzker, Warnock, Ossoff, populism, and why the old "moderate vs progressive" framework may be completely broken.
* [**00:18:23**] Things go fully off the rails in the best way possible: comedy, race, identity, Kill Tony, Chelsea Handler, Italian Americans, and why everybody in America seems determined to argue about literally everything.

This episode is really about identity, generational change, media culture, and the weird emotional place America is sitting in right now. If you've been trying to make sense of where the country is headed -- and why so many people feel disconnected, angry, or exhausted -- this conversation will hit home. And if you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.

--Mike

| | | Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.

[ ](https://heidihall4cong.com/l/Z6E3RxagwTYE)

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.

After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.

Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

subject: This is not ideal
body:
---
Derek, **We have bad news:** Our team relies on donations from supporters like you to fund our work electing Democrats across the country, but in the last few months, we’ve seen a _significant_ slowdown. It’s understandable — especially since Trump and his allies have wreaked havoc on our economy — but it’s making it that much harder for Democrats to fight back. Look at this chart ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-mid-month?refcode=em_20260513_7112_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7112_22930333_hnTOMt&akid=7112%2E22930333%2EhnTOMt) You can see the dropoff we’re talking about — and with our mid-month fundraising deadline coming up, the timing isn’t great. **But here’s the good news:** So far this year, Democrats have overperformed in nearly every major election — including in districts that went to Trump by **double digits** in 2024. It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

clean_body: A historic opportunity | | | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. subject: Can you chip in to help register eligible Latino voters?

body:
Latino communities across the country are facing attacks on all fronts. We need your help to fight back.
#
**Right now, Latino communities across the country are facing attacks on all fronts, Peter.**
As you read this email, names are being **purged** from voter rolls. Families are being **torn apart** by federal agents. Copycat SAVE Acts are being passed at the state level — adding even more**barriers to our right to vote**. And Republicans are rigging maps to try to **silence** our voices.
That’s why, for Latinos, the upcoming midterm elections are very personal. As our families continue to face uncertainty, we have the opportunity to make it clear that we refuse to be ignored or silenced.
That’s why Voto Latino is organizing every day to build sustained Latino political power, the kind that wins elections and forces accountability.
And we need your help to keep going.
We set a goal to raise **$10,000 by midnight on May 16th** so we can keep organizing, keep reaching voters, and keep fighting back against this administration and the lawmakers enabling it.
**[If you’re able, will you pitch in your first $3 contribution to help us hit that goal?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260513-1-ak.Z4uI8p&amount=3&refcode=em20260513-126&t=1&akid=126%2E1366028%2Ey7QZNj)**
Right now, **millions of eligible Latino voters are _still_ unregistered**, even though upcoming elections in key states could be decided by razor-thin margins.
That’s the gap Voto Latino is closing by finding unregistered voters, helping them register, and turning them out to vote.
But Republicans know the power of Latino participation, too. That’s why they keep pushing voter suppression laws and fear-based attacks meant to discourage our communities from showing up.
**Our strategy is simple. We register more Latino voters, mobilize them, and ensure they feel confident to show up to the polls in November. That’s how we’ll win.**
[**Will you help power Voto Latino’s strategy to reach and register as many Latinos as possible before November, and help us reach our $10,000 goal?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260513-1-ak.Z4uI8p&amount=3&refcode=em20260513-126&t=2&akid=126%2E1366028%2Ey7QZNj)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260513-1-ak.Z4uI8p&amount=3&refcode=20260513-126&t=21&akid=126%2E1366028%2Ey7QZNj)**
Thank you for your support.
Voto Latino

body:
We have a
major update in the race for governor here in Michigan:

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/4667?t=1001&akid=1640%2E181023%2ECCA4nd ]Headline: New poll finds big shift in Michigan governor's race

This brand-new poll shows Jocelyn Benson leading the field for governor —
even though one of her opponents has already spent more than $12 million
on ads, while our campaign has spent $0 on TV ads.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/4667?t=1002&akid=1640%2E181023%2ECCA4nd ]Help us keep up this momentum with a donation today.

But what really stands out to us is where the momentum is coming from.

Among the most committed Democratic voters, Jocelyn’s support has grown
even stronger. And among voters who lean Democratic, her support nearly
doubled, while Duggan’s support collapsed.

The pollsters themselves summed it up this way: “Benson’s consolidation of

Peter, The _Voting Rights Act_ was passed in 1965 to stop states and local officials from denying people of color an equal say in our democracy. **The right-wing majority on the Supreme Court recently issued a direct attack on the Voting Rights Act’s power to protect the right to vote for minority community voters.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131346426/620779433/518718595?refcode=AU_MKH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20260513_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNjFkYWIwYy0xNTRmLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zEy7MZTtee3RyJd-_4Yk-LCjBWDwp1aIxRAr2R2j8lg=&emci=d424bc28-124f-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=b61dab0c-154f-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=23190490) The Supreme Court’s decision sets a dangerous precedent that other states will use, and are already weaponizing, to justify racially discriminatory maps and silence voters of color across the country. # **CIA whistleblower accuses Dr. Fauci of "intentional" cover-up of COVID origin**
James Erdman III, a CIA senior operations officer and military veteran, testified Wednesday before the Senate Homeland Security Committee alleging intelligence agencies misled Congress about coronavirus origins while **[taking direct aim at Dr. Anthony Fauci,](https://substack.com/redirect/5781ccec-5cb9-494c-aceb-199c7ee25256?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** former head of the White House Coronavirus Response team.
## [Watch here: ](https://substack.com/redirect/5781ccec-5cb9-494c-aceb-199c7ee25256?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5781ccec-5cb9-494c-aceb-199c7ee25256?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Erdman told senators,** "Dr. Fauci's role in the cover-up was intentional. Dr. Fauci influenced the analytical process and findings by leveraging his position to ensure the IC consulted with a conflicted list of curated subject matter experts, public health officials, and scientists."
* **Warns Congress being misled by intelligence community on biological research** : The whistleblower claimed the CIA and other agencies are failing to provide transparency while calling for sweeping review of federally funded life sciences work including stricter gain-of-function research definitions. Erdman warned "The legislative and executive branches will continue to be misinformed if this type of behavior is not addressed."
* **Co-founded advocacy group challenging federal vaccine mandates** : Erdman previously served with Army's 2nd Battalion, 75th Ranger Regiment before joining CIA in 2013, later co-founding Feds For Freedom during vaccine mandate battles that backed multiple lawsuits against agencies including FBI, Defense Department and NASA alleging religious freedom violations over COVID-19 requirements.

# **AOC leads potential 2028 Democratic field with 26% in AtlasIntel poll, Harris falls to fourth place**
Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez **[topped a new AtlasIntel survey](https://substack.com/redirect/ddebc535-f75b-49a2-952d-2e9161ac72d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of potential 2028 Democratic presidential candidates with 26% support, followed by former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg at 22.4% and California Gov. Gavin Newsom at 21.2%, while Vice President Kamala Harris--who led other recent polls--landed in distant fourth with just 12.9%. The May 4-7 survey of 2,069 U.S. adults carries a +/- 2% margin of error and marks a sharp contrast with earlier polls showing Harris with commanding leads of 38% and 50% respectively.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ddebc535-f75b-49a2-952d-2e9161ac72d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **AOC tells Axelrod her "ambition is way bigger" than any political title**: When asked about future plans by Democratic strategist David Axelrod, Ocasio-Cortez declined to commit to any specific race including challenges to Sen. Chuck Schumer's seat, saying "They assume that my ambition is a title or a seat. And my ambition is way bigger than that" focused on policy goals like single-payer healthcare, living wages and workers' rights.
* **Harris drops biggest 2028 hint at Sharpton convention** : The vice president offered her clearest signal yet about another presidential bid when asked at Rev. Al Sharpton's National Action Network convention, responding "Listen, I might, I might. I'm thinking about it. I'll keep you posted."

Not what I spent my time doing

| | | | |
Peter,
I’ll be honest with you... I’m not great at asking for money. It’s the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn’t spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn’t become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That’s really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it’s going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. I couldn't just sit there.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDUxM19WSi1BUi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4OTY4MTAtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA1MTNfVkotQVIuMTEwMTE3X3QxODk2ODEwLTIwNjgifQ/-W1h7BAwi_6RX3GeK1tUsA)
But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don’t have a massive machine behind me. I don’t have someone who can write blank checks on a whim.
[I just have normal folks like you.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDUxM19WSi1BUi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4OTY4MTAtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA1MTNfVkotQVIuMTEwMTE3X3QxODk2ODEwLTIwNjgifQ/UHDeJ1OqvN9c4BSSXtSpLg)
I know things are tight right now. I see it at the grocery store just like you do. But if you can spare even $5 to help keep a Navy Vet and a Nurse Practitioner in this fight, it would mean the world to me.

clean_body: My momentum in the Minnesota Senate race is picking up fast — and that’s exactly why my opponents just launched their nastiest attacks yet. | Peter, As a former Navy SEAL I’ve been shot at, blown up, and tested in ways most people never experience. While these lies are annoying and slightly comical, they are a different kind of ugly in this battle for the US Senate. It’s the kind of sleazy politics that makes you wonder how low some people will go just to win. I’ve been in this Minnesota Senate race for roughly a year. I’m still not a household name, but something is clearly shifting. Voters across the state are noticing — we’ve now won 13 separate straw polls. I always figured the attacks would come eventually. I just didn’t expect them to get this personal or this dishonest this quickly. Look, I can handle the incoming fire. I’ve taken harder hits in my life. What I can’t accept is watching a critical Senate seat slip away because my opponents would rather sling mud than talk about the future of this country. This seat is too important to let personal attacks decide who serves Minnesota and who helps stop the radical Democratic agenda in Washington. That’s why I’m asking: You may never have heard of me before, and you might not even live in Minnesota — that’s okay. Here’s the truth: I’m not running for the Senate to build a network for some future lobbying gig or private-sector payday. I’m running because America gave me every chance I’ve ever had, and hanging up my uniform didn’t mean I stopped serving. I still have plenty of fight left in me. But That’s why I’m reaching out to fellow patriots like you. This week on _Amped Up_ , Cliff and David Shuster sit down with [Alan Eyre](https://open.substack.com/users/2780513-alan-eyre?utm_source=mentions)--the principal architect of the JCPOA under President Obama and the first Persian-speaking spokesperson the U.S. State Department ever had. This is not a cable-news pundit explaining Iran. This is the man who was in the room when the deal was written, who knows the centrifuges by serial number, and who has spent the last decade watching one administration's strategic disaster compound into the next.
He walks Cliff and David through the math nobody on television will lay out plainly: Iran is now sitting on roughly **440 kilograms --1,000 pounds--of 60% highly enriched uranium**, the IAEA inspectors have been locked out since June 2025, and the 12-day war and the current war have shifted Iran's calculus from "hedge state" to "we might as well weaponize." If you have ever wanted a coherent explanation of how we got from Obama's deal to a botched Iran war to a country full of enrichment we can't monitor, this is that explanation, from the only person actually qualified to give it.
The interview goes further. Eyre lays out what an actual deal with Iran would have to look like now (it's the JCPOA structure--but with intensified verification, downblending, and exports through third countries). He explains why Libya and Ukraine are the cautionary tales every nuclear-aspirant country studies. He names the next domino--**Saudi Arabia gets to a weapon within a Jared-Kushner-affinity-fund-deposit of Iran getting one** --and then he closes with a line that should be on a billboard somewhere in Washington: _" We are livestreaming the fall of the Roman Empire."_ He frames Trump not as the disease but as the symptom of an American system that's been incapacitating itself since the 1970s. It is sober, expert, and unsparing--and Cliff and Shuster, to their credit, mostly get out of the way and let him talk. Pour something. Take an hour. This is the kind of conversation that doesn't happen on cable anymore, because cable can't afford the silence between the answers.
You just read a paragraph that named four countries, two wars, one nuclear inspection regime, and a person who actually wrote a treaty--and got through it without a chyron. That's because _**Blue Amp Media**_ doesn't have an executive producer asking us to cut to commercial before the smart guest finishes his sentence. We have _you_.

He walks Cliff and David through the math nobody on television will lay out plainly: Iran is now sitting on roughly 440 kilograms --1,000 pounds--of 60% highly enriched uranium, the IAEA inspectors have been locked out since June 2025, and the 12-day war and the current war have shifted Iran's calculus from "hedge state" to "we might as well weaponize." If you have ever wanted a coherent explanation of how we got from Obama's deal to a botched Iran war to a country full of enrichment we can't monitor, this is that explanation, from the only person actually qualified to give it. The interview goes further. Eyre lays out what an actual deal with Iran would have to look like now (it's the JCPOA structure--but with intensified verification, downblending, and exports through third countries). He explains why Libya and Ukraine are the cautionary tales every nuclear-aspirant country studies. He names the next domino--Saudi Arabia gets to a weapon within a Jared-Kushner-affinity-fund-deposit of Iran getting one --and then he closes with a line that should be on a billboard somewhere in Washington: " We are livestreaming the fall of the Roman Empire." He frames Trump not as the disease but as the symptom of an American system that's been incapacitating itself since the 1970s. It is sober, expert, and unsparing--and Cliff and Shuster, to their credit, mostly get out of the way and let him talk. Pour something. Take an hour. This is the kind of conversation that doesn't happen on cable anymore, because cable can't afford the silence between the answers. You just read a paragraph that named four countries, two wars, one nuclear inspection regime, and a person who actually wrote a treaty--and got through it without a chyron. That's because Blue Amp Media doesn't have an executive producer asking us to cut to commercial before the smart guest finishes his sentence. We have you. --if our last sponsor revenue note didn't make the math obvious, the corporate networks are not paying for hour-long interviews with retired State Department architects. We are, because subscribers fund it. If you can 't subscribe, throw a few bucks at our Ko-fi--every dollar there pays for one more interview that has to be earned, not booked off a publicist's list.
