The Supreme Court gutted voting rights this month. These upcoming cases could make things even worse. | |
---
Peter, The MAGA-captured Supreme Court handed down one of its worst rulings yet this month. **But they’re not done yet. Tomorrow is**** _another_****decision day.** In **_Louisiana v. Callais_** , the Court gutted what was left of the Voting Rights Act—setting off racial gerrymandering in states across the country, disenfranchising millions of Black and Brown voters, and rigging the 2026 midterms and beyond in favor of Republicans. The hits will keep coming through the rest of the session. **Tomorrow’s decisions could attack trans rights, allow guns in public spaces, and sell even more of our democracy to the rich.** And while early reports indicate that the Court is likely to strike down Trump’s attacks on birthright citizenship, **_nothing can ever be guaranteed with this group of MAGA loyalists_****. Our immigrant communities won’t sleep well until the ruling comes down.** United for Democracy is preparing the big, mass-movement response to each of the following cases:
* **_Wolford v. Lopez_** _-_ The Court could strike down another commonsense law, this time in Hawaii, **making it harder for states to keep guns out of public spaces.**
* _West Virginia v. B.P.J._ and _Little v. Hecox_** __**_-_ The Court could **uphold bans on trans children from playing sports** with their peers—building on last year's ruling that already stripped healthcare access.
* **_NRSC v. FEC_****-** Another ruling could tear down the few remaining campaign spending limits still in place after _Citizens United_ , **letting wealthy donors pour even more money into our elections** through political parties.

This Court has proven time and time again that their priority is the wealthy extremists pulling the strings behind the shadows, not the American people. From their ruling crowning Trump as king in America to stripping voting rights, they’re upholding a system that steals power from us and redistributes it upwards. **The MAGA political machine thinks no one can stop them. That’s where United for Democracy comes in.** We’re the hub of the rapid-response, people-powered answer to Trump and his crew’s attack on our democracy. We’re organizing with allied groups, activists, experts, and organizers across the country to make sure our demands can’t be ignored. name: Christopher Ahuja for Congress
subject: The Momentum is Real in CA-32
body:
This moment is here--let's take it!

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/XxTtUb4YUrX?e=53c7d12fc7&c2id=03e31f49219b7c6e397e6c0d551b29a3)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Dear Friends,This campaign is putting in the work.After taking time to honor Mother’s Day and celebrate the mothers, grandmothers, caregivers, and families who hold our communities together, our team got right back into the field.**In just one day, volunteers knocked on 300 doors across CA-32** — speaking directly with voters about affordability, healthcare, immigration, public safety, and the frustration many feel with politics as usual.One thing is becoming very clear: people are ready for leadership that is visible, accessible, and engaged in the everyday concerns facing this district.That’s why I spent the past few days meeting residents at Miss Donuts in Reseda and Burritos Blvd in Tarzana — listening, answering questions, and continuing conversations with voters where they are.**This campaign is growing neighborhood by neighborhood and block by block because we are building a true grassroots operation powered by people — not political machines or decades of incumbency.** But campaigns like this require resources to compete.**Every door knocked, every volunteer trained, every voter contacted, and every digital ad placed takes investment.** Today, I’m asking for your support to help us:• Expand voter outreach across CA-32
• Recruit and train more volunteers
• Grow our digital communications operation
• Build the infrastructure needed to compete and win**The energy is real. The conversations are real. And so is the opportunity to build something different for this district.** If you believe in people-powered leadership, I hope you’ll contribute today.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Peter, we have a situation
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I have promised from day 1 to treat this fight with the urgency it deserves.
#

Peter, we have a situation.
I have promised from Day 1 to treat this fight with the urgency it deserves.
That means standing up to Trump and his allies in the Senate. It means voting on principle, remembering the Arizonans who sent me to Washington, and remembering to put working communities like the one I came from first.
It also means fighting like hell on the campaign trail. Stumping in battleground states, fundraising for the candidates we need to restore a Democratic majority in the Senate, and **_organizing everywhere.**_
As you might expect, Peter, fighting like hell means we’re spending like hell. So let me show you where our problem is:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may26.lHeo-J&refcode=em260513-1-160&t=1&akid=4130%2E734936%2EoedBrz)
That purple line represents the number of donations we have coming in to continue our fight against MAGA in the Senate and on the trail.
As you can see, we’re trending in the wrong direction right as we come up on our mid-month fundraising deadline in just two days.
That means less money for battleground states. Less money to travel to rallies. Less money to organize. Less money to **_win_** , Peter.
Our mid-month deadline is only two days away, and now you can see the gap in our budget as well as I can. There’s really no better time to contribute.

name: Matias, United We Dream
subject: 👉 Learn about our last training (& how to join the next one)
body:
From NY to LA, we have the power to change these conditions! 🗺️ | | | Hey Peter, **When we say the future we need is within reach, we mean it. And our latest training in New York is proof of it!** We’re living under turbulent conditions that have forced us into a state of survival. * * *
Dear Friend, My name is Kimberly Bretches. I'm a wife and a mother of four young children. And I'm writing to you today because I am out of options and I am terrified. I'll be honest, asking strangers for help doesn't come naturally to me. But neither does the idea of my husband spending the rest of his life in prison for doing his job — so here I am. Chance is a police officer in Austin, Texas. He is, without question, the best man I know. He has spent his career keeping dangerous people off the streets, protecting a city that doesn't always make it easy to do so, and coming home every night to a family that needs him. His supervisors have praised him for his professionalism, for his instincts, for his dedication. He is exactly the kind of officer you want showing up when things go wrong. | By every measure, Chance did everything right. He used department-approved tools, following his training, to protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin.
---
And in May of 2020, things went very wrong in Austin. For three consecutive days, our city was under siege. Violent agitators hurled rocks, frozen water bottles, and exploding fireworks directly at police officers. Buildings were vandalized and looted. Police vehicles were set on fire. A rioter was caught with a Molotov cocktail. Officers were injured. The city was teetering on the edge of complete chaos, and everyone knew it.
On May 31st, the third day, when the mob was larger and more dangerous than it had ever been, Chance was on the front lines. He did what he was trained to do. He deployed non-lethal, department-approved beanbag projectiles to stop the aggression and protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. The crowd eventually dispersed. The city held.
**No one questioned what he did that night. His supervisors praised his response. His department stood behind him.**
And then Austin elected District Attorney José Garza.
Instead of holding the rioters accountable — the ones who threw the fireworks, who lit the fires, who carried the Molotov cocktails — Garza turned his attention to the officers who stopped them. He launched an indiscriminate campaign against law enforcement, using the power of his office not to protect the public, but to make political examples out of good cops.
Chance became one of his targets.
| Chance now faces up to 99 Years in prison — for following his training.
---
My husband now faces up to 99 years in prison. Not because he did anything wrong. Not because his department found fault with his actions. Not because any credible review of that night concluded he acted improperly. But because one politically-motivated prosecutor decided the officers who held the line deserved to be punished for holding it. This case has been grinding through the system for years now. The trial has already been delayed several times and is **now scheduled for June of this year.** Every continuance, every filing, every hearing means more hours of legal work, and more bills our family has to find a way to pay. I am asking for your help because we cannot do this alone. The National Center for Police Defense has been in Chance's corner, and your donation goes toward funding his legal defense, ensuring he has the representation he deserves as he walks into that courtroom in June.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2a0d0280-17e2-4530-be5a-17fd7dd9bb2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Two brothers arrested last year after allegedly admitting to drunk driving to police have ties to multiple home healthcare providers in Maine and have worked to help other providers set up MaineCare billing and pass audits amid a nationwide crackdown on healthcare fraud.
[RELATED: [President of Five-Star Homecare Ordered to Repay Nearly $400K Worked at Three Other Home Healthcare Providers Before Moving to Turkmenistan...](https://substack.com/redirect/933bc857-258f-4165-adce-e0b951eb9e9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)]
Manoach and Muhoza Bizumuremyi both operated businesses concurrently out of the exact same Bangor apartment building and unit.
## The Crime
In April 2025, the Bangor Police Department responded to a report of an erratic driver operating on Broadway at approximately 9:00 p.m.
[RELATED: [Brothers Arrested for OUI in Bangor After Admitting to Police They Both Drove Same Car While Drunk...](https://substack.com/redirect/bb82d78f-1af3-4087-a739-d73ad66c3211?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)]
Witnesses told police that they saw the vehicle pull over and saw the driver and passenger swap seats.
Police located the vehicle and identified the suspects as the Bizumuremyi brothers as they were standing outside the vehicle in a parking lot.
According to police, both men admitted to driving the vehicle, said that they swapped drivers, and admitted that neither should have been driving. Swapping drivers effectively secured OUI charges for both brothers, rather than just the original driver.
They were arrested after failing a field sobriety test.
Manoach, the younger brother, drove for the majority of the trip and allegedly had a blood alcohol level of 0.23%, compared with the 0.08% legal limit in the state.
He was charged with an OUI.
Muhoza was found with a 0.17 percent blood alcohol level and was found to have a previous offense within the past ten years. He was also charged with an OUI.
It does not appear that either man remains incarcerated.
According to Recently Booked, Manoach was [arrested ](https://substack.com/redirect/a70738dc-0808-42f6-ae66-46029fa84af6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)again on September 4 on charges of operating a vehicle with a license suspended or revoked following an OUI, failing to register a vehicle within 30 days, and violating conditions of release.
The Maine Wire submitted a Freedom of Access Act (FOAA) request to the Bangor Police Department, requesting all incident reports involving both Bizumuremyis, and we are currently awaiting a response.
## Manoach
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d0a74a5b-63f7-407d-961f-e3cfe95199cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Manoach from his LinkedIn Page (left) and Manoach's 2025 Mugshot (right)
According to business [records](https://substack.com/redirect/dea0c910-8181-4f1e-9a80-c5578bcba164?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Manoach served as the registered agent for the now-defunct Unity Healthcare Services.
Records place Unity's mailing address at a private mailbox (PMB) and its head office at 269 Center Street, Apartment 2, in Bangor.
Unity's head office address, shared by a business registered to Manoach's brother, appears to be a [residential](https://substack.com/redirect/9c3d5a32-117d-4ad6-b02d-fc0d33e343bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) apartment building, not an office space.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab27d53c-df23-42c6-af9a-a4dcc63fda8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image of 269 Center Street from Redfin.com
Unity, formed in August 2023, was administratively dissolved for a week in November 2024 after failing to file an annual report and continued operations after its reinstatement until the business' status was officially cancelled on January 5, 2026, just two days after filing its final annual report.
The defunct business never billed Medicaid, according to payment records obtained by The Maine Wire, and does not appear to have a website. It is unclear whether it ever provided any actual medical services, though it is listed as a home health care provider on multiple websites that aggregate medical provider information.
Though his defunct business does not appear in licensing records, Manoach personally maintains a [license](https://substack.com/redirect/d9038417-166f-4de7-85e4-618200934283?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a certified residential medication aide, a certification he has held since February 2023.
His [LinkedIn](https://substack.com/redirect/48f0013c-3bbd-46ec-857f-dbbf562ff5e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) profile sheds more light on Unity. There, he lists his role at his operation as a self-employed consultant.
In that role, he helped multiple healthcare agencies to become accredited and helped them in the face of compliance audits, though there is no way to determine which Maine-based home healthcare providers benefited from his assistance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e446bdc7-85d3-4848-9e05-981f59ef6162?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
His current LinkedIn page shows a "Ready to Work" banner and indicates that his last job working at Unity ended in December.
Prior to his work at Unity, Manoach worked as a house manager/operational manager at [Peace Residential Care](https://substack.com/redirect/95d7990e-12ba-4b5b-b52a-39b583ed88ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Peace Residential provides both residential and at-home care and is a significant Medicaid biller.
They first started billing in 2022, and from 2022 through 2025, they billed $17,431,776, with billing ramping up each year. In 2025 alone the provider billed $6,940,659.
Peace Residential is registered to CEO [Guillaume Ishimwe](https://substack.com/redirect/28fb57bb-29ae-4be5-80fb-d69cce2f537d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who worked at the [Maine Association for New Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/42c43903-fcda-4ac5-9dee-360dd134ae47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)before founding his multi-million dollar healthcare operation.
Manoach's earliest listed job is from 2020, when he worked for the DHL shipping company.
He graduated from the University of North Texas with a bachelor's degree, and an associate's degree from Tarrant County College in Arizona, but it is not clear whether he is from there, some other state, or whether he immigrated to the U.S. from another country.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.._5V3RL_Oxave2zQUi1u811LxYl-CHtvuxrw3to6Lex4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=195091781)
## Muhoza
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/de78944a-b06c-4855-994a-bd2321f9af9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Muhoza from his LinkedIn Page (left) and Muhoza's 2025 Mugshot (right)
The older Bizumuremyi, like his younger brother, has ties to Texas, Arizona, and Maine and has also worked to help other healthcare agencies set up MaineCare billing.
Unlike his brother, Muhoza has a business that remains active. According to [records](https://substack.com/redirect/e0a3394e-5f34-42d8-a568-bc1cf6a75966?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he serves as the registered agent for [Chiloh Residential Care](https://substack.com/redirect/3c836fb7-18ba-42a4-b370-7e93ba97644c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). According to their website, they provide home care services, but they do not appear in state licensing records, and there is no indication that they have ever held a license to provide medical services.
Chiloh has also never billed Medicaid, and it is not clear, despite claims on their website, whether they actually provide any services.
The phone number for Chiloh has a Fort Worth, Texas area code.
The business began in February 2023, with a mailing address at 269 Center Street, Apartment 2, in Bangor. Its head office address lists the same street address, omits the apartment number, and, inexplicably, includes an email address.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2367bd91-8272-4212-b832-da1d9a321e67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While Chiloh does not appear in licensing records, Muhoza is personally [licensed ](https://substack.com/redirect/a7505f19-286c-4dc0-b7a4-a399f49b5bae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)as a certified residential medication aide.
The Maine Wire reached out to the phone number listed on Chiloh's, which seems to be a Texas cell phone. The call went straight to voice mail, but the number then texted, asking if it would work to talk later.
After we responded, asking questions about the business and asking when would be a good time to talk, the number stopped responding.
_After the publication of this article, Muhoza reached out by phone. He clarified that Chiloah has never operated as a healthcare agency because they were unable to get licensed. He also claimed that he never saw The Maine Wire 's text messages_ _and denied having anything to do with audits_.
Muhoza's LinkedIn strangely makes no mention of Chiloh and claims that he is currently pursuing a master's in analytics at Northeastern University in Portland.
From December 2023 to December 2024, according to his LinkedIn, Muhoza worked as a "content specialist" for Nile Research and Communications.
In that capacity, he helped clients become certified as home healthcare providers, assisted them in producing paperwork showing compliance with Maine Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) policies, and helped ensure that they could bill MaineCare.
"[He] Supported entrepreneurs in establishing their businesses by facilitating LLC formation with the Maine Secretary of State, preparing and filing annual reports, obtaining necessary EINs and NPI numbers, and navigating MaineCare provider enrollment steps to enable seamless entry into the HCBS provider network," says his LinkedIn Page.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/950688d3-a7f8-4ca3-9591-ac099dd2d346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
From January 2022 to May 2023, he worked as a "business intelligence analyst" for [National HME](https://substack.com/redirect/cee81690-12d3-4c0a-855b-b5a83887ac6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a Texas-based provider of hospice care, among other things.
Though neither Bizumuremyi brother's business billed MaineCare, their full impact on Maine's health care fraud industry, through their consulting and assisting other providers set up their billing, may be far greater than that of many individual providers.

By Seamus Othot, Maine Wire Reporter May 13 | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Two brothers arrested last year after allegedly admitting to drunk driving to police have ties to multiple home healthcare providers in Maine and have worked to help other providers set up MaineCare billing and pass audits amid a nationwide crackdown on healthcare fraud. ] Manoach and Muhoza Bizumuremyi both operated businesses concurrently out of the exact same Bangor apartment building and unit. The Crime In April 2025, the Bangor Police Department responded to a report of an erratic driver operating on Broadway at approximately 9:00 p.m. ] Witnesses told police that they saw the vehicle pull over and saw the driver and passenger swap seats. Police located the vehicle and identified the suspects as the Bizumuremyi brothers as they were standing outside the vehicle in a parking lot. According to police, both men admitted to driving the vehicle, said that they swapped drivers, and admitted that neither should have been driving. Swapping drivers effectively secured OUI charges for both brothers, rather than just the original driver. They were arrested after failing a field sobriety test. Manoach, the younger brother, drove for the majority of the trip and allegedly had a blood alcohol level of 0.23%, compared with the 0.08% legal limit in the state. He was charged with an OUI. Muhoza was found with a 0.17 percent blood alcohol level and was found to have a previous offense within the past ten years. He was also charged with an OUI. It does not appear that either man remains incarcerated. According to Recently Booked, Manoach was on September 4 on charges of operating a vehicle with a license suspended or revoked following an OUI, failing to register a vehicle within 30 days, and violating conditions of release. The Maine Wire submitted a Freedom of Access Act (FOAA) request to the Bangor Police Department, requesting all incident reports involving both Bizumuremyis, and we are currently awaiting a response. Manoach | | ---|---|--- Manoach from his LinkedIn Page (left) and Manoach's 2025 Mugshot (right) According to business , Manoach served as the registered agent for the now-defunct Unity Healthcare Services. Records place Unity's mailing address at a private mailbox (PMB) and its head office at 269 Center Street, Apartment 2, in Bangor. Unity's head office address, shared by a business registered to Manoach's brother, appears to be a apartment building, not an office space. | | ---|---|--- Image of 269 Center Street from Redfin.com Unity, formed in August 2023, was administratively dissolved for a week in November 2024 after failing to file an annual report and continued operations after its reinstatement until the business' status was officially cancelled on January 5, 2026, just two days after filing its final annual report. The defunct business never billed Medicaid, according to payment records obtained by The Maine Wire, and does not appear to have a website. It is unclear whether it ever provided any actual medical services, though it is listed as a home health care provider on multiple websites that aggregate medical provider information. Though his defunct business does not appear in licensing records, Manoach personally maintains a as a certified residential medication aide, a certification he has held since February 2023. His profile sheds more light on Unity. There, he lists his role at his operation as a self-employed consultant. In that role, he helped multiple healthcare agencies to become accredited and helped them in the face of compliance audits, though there is no way to determine which Maine-based home healthcare providers benefited from his assistance. | | ---|---|--- His current LinkedIn page shows a "Ready to Work" banner and indicates that his last job working at Unity ended in December. Prior to his work at Unity, Manoach worked as a house manager/operational manager at . Peace Residential provides both residential and at-home care and is a significant Medicaid biller. They first started billing in 2022, and from 2022 through 2025, they billed $17,431,776, with billing ramping up each year. In 2025 alone the provider billed $6,940,659. Peace Residential is registered to CEO , who worked at the founding his multi-million dollar healthcare operation. Manoach's earliest listed job is from 2020, when he worked for the DHL shipping company. He graduated from the University of North Texas with a bachelor's degree, and an associate's degree from Tarrant County College in Arizona, but it is not clear whether he is from there, some other state, or whether he immigrated to the U.S. from another country. Muhoza | | ---|---|--- Muhoza from his LinkedIn Page (left) and Muhoza's 2025 Mugshot (right) The older Bizumuremyi, like his younger brother, has ties to Texas, Arizona, and Maine and has also worked to help other healthcare agencies set up MaineCare billing. Unlike his brother, Muhoza has a business that remains active. According to , he serves as the registered agent for . According to their website, they provide home care services, but they do not appear in state licensing records, and there is no indication that they have ever held a license to provide medical services. Chiloh has also never billed Medicaid, and it is not clear, despite claims on their website, whether they actually provide any services. The phone number for Chiloh has a Fort Worth, Texas area code. The business began in February 2023, with a mailing address at 269 Center Street, Apartment 2, in Bangor. Its head office address lists the same street address, omits the apartment number, and, inexplicably, includes an email address. | | ---|---|--- While Chiloh does not appear in licensing records, Muhoza is personally a certified residential medication aide. The Maine Wire reached out to the phone number listed on Chiloh's, which seems to be a Texas cell phone. The call went straight to voice mail, but the number then texted, asking if it would work to talk later. After we responded, asking questions about the business and asking when would be a good time to talk, the number stopped responding. After the publication of this article, Muhoza reached out by phone. He clarified that Chiloah has never operated as a healthcare agency because they were unable to get licensed. He also claimed that he never saw The Maine Wire 's text messages and denied having anything to do with audits. Muhoza's LinkedIn strangely makes no mention of Chiloh and claims that he is currently pursuing a master's in analytics at Northeastern University in Portland. From December 2023 to December 2024, according to his LinkedIn, Muhoza worked as a "content specialist" for Nile Research and Communications. In that capacity, he helped clients become certified as home healthcare providers, assisted them in producing paperwork showing compliance with Maine Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) policies, and helped ensure that they could bill MaineCare. "[He] Supported entrepreneurs in establishing their businesses by facilitating LLC formation with the Maine Secretary of State, preparing and filing annual reports, obtaining necessary EINs and NPI numbers, and navigating MaineCare provider enrollment steps to enable seamless entry into the HCBS provider network," says his LinkedIn Page. | | ---|---|--- From January 2022 to May 2023, he worked as a "business intelligence analyst" for , a Texas-based provider of hospice care, among other things. Though neither Bizumuremyi brother's business billed MaineCare, their full impact on Maine's health care fraud industry, through their consulting and assisting other providers set up their billing, may be far greater than that of many individual providers. Peter, _It’s been two weeks. _ It feels more like two decades since the Supreme Court gutted one of the last-standing pillars of the Voting Rights Act. Ever since, Republicans across the country have been moving at a breakneck speed to redraw maps and eliminate voting power for Black and brown communities. All of this has happened since SCOTUS’s ruling:
* **Florida:** Republicans passed a new, extreme gerrymander the same day of the ruling — it cracks apart numerous districts to give the GOP an unearned advantage in as many as four new seats — a blatant violation of the state’s constitution.
* **Tennessee:** The Republican-controlled legislature has already passed a new congressional map that eliminates the state’s only majority-Black district.
* **Alabama:** Republicans are desperately moving to pave the way for reversion to a map that robs Black voters of equal representation.
* **Louisiana:** The governor declared a “state of emergency” to cancel Louisiana’s 2026 primary election — an unprecedented move that wiped out thousands of votes to gerrymander the state’s map ahead of the midterms.
* **Arizona:** Republicans are openly exploring a legal challenge to redraw several of Arizona’s majority-Latino districts.
* **South Carolina:** Republicans in South Carolina are weighing a map redraw that could give their party a chance to win all seven of the state’s congressional seats.

**Peter, we’ll say it: Republicans want a new Jim Crow era in American politics.** And in Virginia late last week, the state supreme court struck down the new map that voters approved in April — a shocking and devastating move that undeniably helps Republicans in their plot to steal the midterms. **The GOP will stop at nothing to hold on to power, and right now, they’re getting their way. Our mission is more urgent than ever.** [**That’s why we’re asking you to rush in a donation to help ensure we can fight back against those trying to usher in a new Jim Crow era. name: James Carville
subject: Meat-grinder
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
This is one of the best places you can spend your dollar right now.
Politics is a _meat-grinder._ It takes good people with ambition and squeezes them to their limit.
So when a guy comes along like Bob Brooks, who has actually been through the wringer, lived a working class life as a firefighter and landscaper, you gotta POUNCE at the opportunity.
_That’s why Pete Buttigieg, Josh Shapiro, and I are lining up behind him._
And that’s why I’m asking you to do the same.
[**I need you to ignore the noise, hunker down, and split a donation between Bob Brooks and Congresswoman Sarah McBride today. That way Bob can flip this tossup seat in PA-07 and help Democrats end the utter madness coming out of Washington, DC - > **](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260513-2.cC9_UA&refcode=em20260513-3252&t=1&akid=3252%2E21716%2ESKBeY1)
**[Donate »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260513-2.cC9_UA&refcode=em20260513-3252&t=20&akid=3252%2E21716%2ESKBeY1)**
Let me tell you: this guy is special.
Bob’s rushed into burning buildings. He’s delivered beers and worked on a factory floor. He’s led a union, sat across from politicians of both parties, and taken them to task for denying his members the benefits they’re due.
That’s the kind of courage I looked for when I ran campaigns.
You know, few people actually know what it’s like to work yourself ragged. _I mean ragged._ But Bob’s done it. He’s done it to avoid losing his home and to afford to put food on his kitchen table.
Candidates like Bob are a diamond in the rough.
And I can count on ONE HAND the number of times I’ve seen a gem like Bob running for a seat that could decide control of the House. PA-07 in the Lehigh Valley is seriously that important — came down to 4,000 votes last time.
So, I hope that settles it. [**If you’re wavering, you have my word that this is one of the best places you can spend your dollar right now. Trump Meets Xi in Beijing

President Trump landed in Beijing Tuesday for a multi-day summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping, with [actual meetings now underway](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuunDAURb_GdB75AQMULtLQ3bQpkfEDjsYYy-c45PMj0qS_9dZa2lq_vtYvCwny_tOewVSKq7_8iiVkF2qplqiA-2ArxVbAY1VCvbkYuNRrTqvsvPHOW-m6YOQ4TqPs1Sy6w0xK60F4Hed39HEQapz7Wc4iRCVdP4sOzKMSg9RKy0mMr6mXQU5euH5SwzZG1gubQqVXDaVtCZzNZPETr-rCy11nl8xBVJDpH0wtTC33fb9qaBQqPjtTy9YQckBkarGNLuRUbcZyVbIEV2ZqodrOwv8AvwPsBydbIUbuGiHXgm-QElyZw_kwyE-b7R78o_GBl4YH_9-DqaWrxpf7gfA9sl7sp4X07yt9I-1vo_4GAAD__wzZigY). Trade, Taiwan, Iran, and rare earths are all on the table -- a sweeping agenda for what may be the most consequential bilateral summit in years. Trump touched down with an unusual entourage: Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, and a delegation of top CEOs rode Air Force One into Beijing. [Reports out of the summit](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1urDAUBOCnMR3If6zZwsVt6Pa2KZF9fFhO1hjL9oY8fkQeIdUUI30jzcdjeTiKlJ7_3Y62tHUJR1hqxgRYcnGtZYJXfefsCtVtkVzeej72Qi0pLqILNkBwAjq0wpjJCC3vvNusMR694ygC-KDFut65VuMKQipEfb91ZC-Kj0JJJSZuhkkLFFPgoCc5erMyzV3E0oaC-e0jgUvN1dd6FMABjr2LdmstV6b-MTkzOZ_nOUDycJVMzhfP5MxHJmehmJxbee-5h42S67-p90iflJ79jtiuBDzqsLU9dsWGfFKMVG-Gaf7cHcXfxfaHg76s_AkAAP__lOt0qA) indicate both sides are weighing tariff cuts on roughly $30 billion in imports as part of a managed trade framework -- a significant potential concession from both governments. The Strait of Hormuz and Beijing's ties to Tehran are also reportedly on the agenda, adding a security dimension to what began as a trade negotiation. [Markets and allies alike](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1urDAQxfGnMR1oZjBrKFzchm5vmxLN-mOx1oBlmxDl6aPNI6Q_Oj_p_3Ff7hxi2J__eXM6V7_Ywy4lud24nDLXmoJ5lTMlzqGsCwHdWhha7Jc9LthYbY1lNI3TqNSoUNIEzao9eOP9A9goZsRRWuMIJjkpRulvvgn6fQUD9tTjCKobJTocLRg50vBQXkjg6HLtskvnIwbDe-Xy8kc2rjPH1kS91pqK6P8JmgXN13V16YihBnO8B4Lm3V1F0PyWBM0wCJqxFzTXfG6pLee2hdp-hbZmtq5dj7yd3y3AhMM09k3WNl0hxlBuSkh4bhzir1z_EOpT008AAAD__04qdqM) are watching every readout for signals on where the relationship lands. ★★★
Patel Erupts at Senate

FBI Director Kash Patel appeared before the Senate Appropriations Committee for a budget hearing that turned into a full-on brawl. [Senators on both sides](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGupSAURb8GOwwcVLwFxTR0b9opzRGOVyIXCeAz7-8nzidMt4qdvXfWn6_lC0MM6f0bP2RK2xZ_-qVmSo5KLthaDu6oV85YQt0XEDBxMXKplhQX2XnjnUfpOjJS61nLAV6i282qNgd62qYR1KSFVgoVAc3rtHmEce2CearEKBUoOQvdz4MkOXvhhhnGVW9sEBiptL5QvtYYHKaG9djO4qh356eLZm8tV6Z-MbAM7H3f_VWxnR5_ngADW9tZfhjYRHdlYPMZQwvuwWecgRUjAyuBgT2w7jxjo8grJWzEd8IS0pv7EtLxwJU9Nqqcx_BNDOxLCND6NQmhGdiuGJ_vEGOok2aDeH8wxH9H2394_TbwNwAA___V4IWr) pressed Patel on the FBI's funding request -- and, more pointedly, on reports of excessive drinking on the job. The sharpest exchange came with Sen. Chris Van Hollen (D-MD). Patel called the drinking allegations a "total farce" and [challenged the senator](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LHS2yAQBOCnQR0eOCNLLijS0P1pU2rOcLIYIUQ4ZCVvn1Ee4e93vt3ZX1_TF8YU8_snbmRrm6ewh4kLZU-1VGytRL_yUQrWyMsECh5S9VLfp5wm3QUbfEDtO7J6GMZBG3iqbrEzemXmx1Nj3_uXeRhPI81PUEBPM_u-i_aiVK_vcNejGm6j0aTHoLwZoX8NszAKE9V2q1SOV4oec0Ne5716uvl965JdWiss7j8EOAHuPM_bibzE_G57Lju3KybAZWxxz5gkkz9qbH8FuKtcgFO9AKdBgFuRF1mwUZIJeSGW-9FkwnPDlSrL3wfxxUj644k5fkiGGvMa81uA66oN5YwpRX4Mwqj3hjH9X9m-cerHwr8AAAD__5KiiRQ) to submit to a mutual "audit" -- a line that had the room buzzing and the substance of the testimony largely buried. The confrontation overshadowed the FBI's actual budget arguments. [Republicans and Democrats alike](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLHOpCAURp9GOwwgDlhQbGP3b7ulucJVyNwBAsz4-pvZR9juS77k5OT8-dl_IFJM1294oa393H32eyuYHNZSofcS3bO9S4EaW9gllw_GFybmPdEuRm-98yDciFZobbRQcuVjsOZ4mPXQXsyHFwYMqGMVWp5KycUpsY7RflF8EbOcheF6MkqgMJ47ZeRy6HNQHAhrnyqW90HRQerQnmeuDieXXyPZ0Htpw_xrkNsgt_u-p3S4hHf7_oPcSqbYo2uD3FxOV8X2nU9ogRXoSMyFGhv7QGIhE2FivYJHBuRyyMSACC_oMafGGiboyAJCjeli1SWYlTJcjdX6ckei2B56UPx6QaR_gv0_en6s_BsAAP__w5KHjA) raised questions about Patel's leadership as the swamp aimed skepticism aimed squarely at a Trump-appointed director. ★★★
GOP Housing Standoff Deepens

A rare intraparty standoff is taking shape on Capitol Hill over housing. President Trump and Senate Republicans are pushing the House to pass [the Senate's affordability bill](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDFuxCAQAF-DO5_YtTFOQZHG3aVNaXELtleHAQHOfT-6PCH1SDPSfN_Xu-XAcf-ypzelbatLbq3ZR_IlF9taZnrWK2dbuB4rSpx6qXoY1hhW6Jxx5CxQ5w1oPWsY8UN2h1EjEMxWSiKlcUM1EYAcpm3ykgYJHZu3SioYcIBZ6ts8gofZSRpnVA-9iVHa4Eu7FZ-vR2Cysdn63FIhf6N0dsEcreUqhk-Bi8ClHf7gEN5M4HKk00f_qgIX606OXFuxjVMUuKhZD0rJvpXrzD2luBdfa3-kq3Lc-weH0O8pC1y6Ylx-cQhcJy1GuZ-W_wpd-8esH4O_AQAA__8EIXly) as written -- but House Republicans are digging in, insisting on substantive changes before they move it. The White House drew a firm line Wednesday: pass the Senate version without revision. House Republicans are pressing ahead anyway, [pushing changes](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLHOpCAUhZ8GOyaAOGBBsY3dv-2W5sq9KhkUAji-_sZ9hK2_k3NOvj8_8w-EGM7tNxzkSltnTDjXTKenkgu0loP_1CtnKKHusxLqzcXAZT-fcZYdOvQI0nfkpDHWSK1G0e0OjDQAsBAJBPJaD6MeFovjiqvH_t0F91SJQfaql1aYl9WSpEXhtVXDYlamBUQq7VUoX0sMHs4G9bOm4unl09FFt7eWK-t_MTUxNd33_cophhZ8egJMTTF8iV8ZoVFlanoWmZrEwNQke6Ymn86tUH3Ynq5KfEuZRwKkUvk3NeJw0ImE_MHh3PgSYuRCjNJaK7riMN8hxlDfhmmxHRDiv2_tP1R-nfobAAD__8Itg4M) that include a ban on large investors purchasing single-family homes -- a populist provision with real implementation questions. With midterms approaching, housing affordability is a political live wire neither side can afford to fumble. [The standoff](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDGO6yAURVeDO1uAscEFxW_c5bdTWs-P54BCMAKcbH80kWYDU13pFudI5-u23SDEkO7_4Um2tGNzp9tqpoRUcoHWcsBHvXKGEqrfJJdzz6dejFuKm-icdehAYEdWaG20UHLhnbeLWWCf5sMp4mJSfN6NWfSCiHQshxy7YH9QfBKjHIXhejBKkDCOozJy2vXBFIdIpQ2F8rXHgJAa1MdxFqQBz2cXrW8tVzb-Y3Jlcs1XQr-f7zgkelcmVygtYCQm1xdcsf1u78-rhnTvPXzOrliX3yHGUGfNFL8_IcSPof0hyMvK7wAAAP__JD5wvg) may be the clearest signal yet that Trump's coalition is pulling in competing directions on domestic policy.

Spencer Pratt's insurgent Los Angeles Mayoral campaign gained steam with [Paris Hilton and Kritin Cavallari](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DGPozAQBeBfA52RbUjMFS6uocu1V6LxeAgjjLFsJ2z-_SrR_oKtn_T0vvf_Nt-AA8f7P9jJ5rrM_vBzSRSRcspQa2LcyiMlyFzWWUt9FfIiVD_HMKvWW48eFLZklTGjUYP-I9vV6qtxTmpJvTTOLYseNSrsUfbkgNC3bN9V8qJ63atRmm4cFKnRSxxGfXFmaQYJgXLtMqWHC4wQK5RtOTJSh8feBrvWmkrT_2301OjpPM9uOb4ineWdN3qiWClX4LhTrI2eflji4ypih9eRIYj8iMIBbuTFRylWDvWIYstcKkeB8IQQILNACuQy15fw_GRPwhMliqXN1qeTQ-ByNc0g7ztw-Iysv_j0afV3AAAA__8P_Yw2) backing his bid. This is former Rep. Adam Kinzinger.
#### **[I'm reaching out to ask for your support of my friend Harry Dunn, the former Capitol Police Officer and Democrat running for Congress in MD-05. Read on for more, or pitch in right now if you're ready to help him win his competitive primary next month:](https://substack.com/redirect/04c0f7ec-f348-4f56-903c-41357ffd86a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CHIP IN NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/04c0f7ec-f348-4f56-903c-41357ffd86a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I didn't wake up on January 6, 2021, knowing Donald Trump would incite a violent insurrection on Capitol grounds. Neither did Harry. We both went to the Capitol to do our jobs and put our oath to our country above all else.
After witnessing the violence of that day, I had no choice but to vote to impeach Donald Trump. I was one of the ONLY House Republicans to serve on the January 6 committee to hold him accountable.
As a result, I received constant death threats. My own party ostracized me. But I will _never_ regret putting our democracy first. That's why I know Harry will put our democracy first in Washington. He stood between Trump's violent mob and our democracy on January 6 -- and democracy won.
We can't afford two more years of Trump's disastrous trifecta. We need courageous leaders like Harry in Washington to stand up to Trump and fight for our freedoms.
#### **[But Harry's already up against a flood of dark money, and he needs the support of grassroots donors like you to get to Congress. We're only 6 weeks out from his primary, so will you help him get across the finish line with a contribution right now?](https://substack.com/redirect/04c0f7ec-f348-4f56-903c-41357ffd86a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CHIP IN NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/04c0f7ec-f348-4f56-903c-41357ffd86a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Like Harry, I'm a proud dad. When I look into my son Christian's eyes, I don't want to feel shame or regret. I want to feel hope. I want to tell him I played a part in standing up to Donald Trump. Thank you for joining me in this fight.
-- Adam Kinzinger
Fmr. U.S. Congressman, IL-16

# [You gotta be joking](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=197581953&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3NTgxOTUzLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg3MTU3NDQsImV4cCI6MTc4MTMwNzc0NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.LljkFgubUqjqt9sNZURDRpoEnQ59JwX2Fhsk5nb8u0s)
### Mike Rogers is pretending to be an expert in Michigan manufacturing by wearing a new Carhartt jacket.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| May 13
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL3lvdS1nb3R0YS1iZS1qb2tpbmc_.ty26tIi-aP7aRP-bti4-X8oej-T01lES3C9o2YK3iRY?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/you-gotta-be-joking?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Mike Rogers is now on the air with his newest commercial. He's spending six figures on an ad buy to try to sell himself as some big champion for Michigan manufacturing.
I'm sorry for being blunt, but give me a freaking break.
Here's the truth: Mike Rogers is a millionaire carpetbagger from Florida backed by out-of-state MAGA billionaires, and they'll say anything to buy this seat for Trump's agenda.
Rogers is NOT the guy who is going to look out for Michigan workers.
I've spent my career actually fighting for Michigan manufacturing. I served as chief of staff on President Obama's auto rescue when people were ready to write off our state and our workers. I fought to protect good jobs, bring investment home, keep plants open, and stand up for the generations of working families who make Michigan what it is.
**Mike Rogers is just a rich Florida guy in a brand-new Carhartt jacket pretending he understands Michigan grit.**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/46ccb0e0-6143-4977-a692-fbfae03145da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Michigan manufacturing is not a campaign prop for a commercial. It is not a costume you put on for the cameras and then toss in the back seat of your SUV on the way to the airport back to Florida.
It is generations of people getting up before dawn, putting in an honest day's work, and helping build this country.
It is calloused hands and shop floors and union halls.
It is pride.
It is who we are.
That's why it makes me so damn angry to see people use Michigan manufacturing to score cheap political points without doing the work. **[Because this is not some talking point for a commercial to me- these are the people I love.](https://substack.com/redirect/46ccb0e0-6143-4977-a692-fbfae03145da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I was born and raised here. I grew up helping with my parents' small landscaping business - covered in grime and learning a relentless work ethic.
Look, I'm not a millionaire. I don't have a mansion in Florida like Mike Rogers. But I do have the lessons my parents taught me: work hard, look out for your community, and never forget where you came from.
That's why Rogers' ad bothers me so much. He's borrowing the look of Michigan grit without any of the actual record to back it up.
That's not how this works.
And the fact that he is already on the air this early tells you something, too. We are still six months away from Election Day, and national Republicans are already spending serious money to boost Rogers and define this race.
Why? Because they know Michigan matters. They know the road to Senate control runs right through this state.
They also know that if Michiganders get the full story about Millionaire Mike - and about the MAGA Texas oil billionaire backing him - they have a problem.
Let me just say plainly what I think is going on here:
Mike Rogers and the GOP think Michigan is for sale. They think if they spend enough money, run enough "manufacturing" ads, and put the right jacket on the right guy, they can buy themselves a Senate seat.
No.
Michiganders are smarter than that. People here can spot a fake.
This state I love deserves someone who has actually been in the fight for workers. It does not need somebody who flies in, films a commercial, and expects people to forget where he lives or who he serves.
And I, for one, am not going to stand by while somebody pretends to be _for_ Michigan manufacturing while also standing with the same MAGA crowd that has made life harder for working people.
[Michigan deserves the real thing. A fighter. That's me. That's why I'm in this.](https://substack.com/redirect/46ccb0e0-6143-4977-a692-fbfae03145da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/46ccb0e0-6143-4977-a692-fbfae03145da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
More soon.
With grit,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

Here's the truth: Mike Rogers is a millionaire carpetbagger from Florida backed by out-of-state MAGA billionaires, and they'll say anything to buy this seat for Trump's agenda. Rogers is NOT the guy who is going to look out for Michigan workers. I've spent my career actually fighting for Michigan manufacturing. I served as chief of staff on President Obama's auto rescue when people were ready to write off our state and our workers. I fought to protect good jobs, bring investment home, keep plants open, and stand up for the generations of working families who make Michigan what it is. Mike Rogers is just a rich Florida guy in a brand-new Carhartt jacket pretending he understands Michigan grit. Michigan manufacturing is not a campaign prop for a commercial. It is not a costume you put on for the cameras and then toss in the back seat of your SUV on the way to the airport back to Florida. It is generations of people getting up before dawn, putting in an honest day's work, and helping build this country. It is calloused hands and shop floors and union halls. It is pride. It is who we are. That's why it makes me so damn angry to see people use Michigan manufacturing to score cheap political points without doing the work. I was born and raised here. I grew up helping with my parents' small landscaping business - covered in grime and learning a relentless work ethic. Look, I'm not a millionaire. I don't have a mansion in Florida like Mike Rogers. But I do have the lessons my parents taught me: work hard, look out for your community, and never forget where you came from. That's why Rogers' ad bothers me so much. He's borrowing the look of Michigan grit without any of the actual record to back it up. That's not how this works. And the fact that he is already on the air this early tells you something, too. We are still six months away from Election Day, and national Republicans are already spending serious money to boost Rogers and define this race. Why? Because they know Michigan matters. They know the road to Senate control runs right through this state. They also know that if Michiganders get the full story about Millionaire Mike - and about the MAGA Texas oil billionaire backing him - they have a problem. Let me just say plainly what I think is going on here: Mike Rogers and the GOP think Michigan is for sale. They think if they spend enough money, run enough "manufacturing" ads, and put the right jacket on the right guy, they can buy themselves a Senate seat. No. Michiganders are smarter than that. People here can spot a fake. This state I love deserves someone who has actually been in the fight for workers. It does not need somebody who flies in, films a commercial, and expects people to forget where he lives or who he serves. And I, for one, am not going to stand by while somebody pretends to be for Michigan manufacturing while also standing with the same MAGA crowd that has made life harder for working people. More soon. With grit, Haley A personal note from Haley 👋 I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love. But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican. I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win. If you're with me, will you chip in today?
